jobs.title: Senior Creative Lead (8+ years)
jobs.description:
Briefly about ourselves

Random is an experience design studio based in Amsterdam and Paris. Our work comes to life where the digital and the physical are fluid. We use technology in a human, tangible way and so invite people to connect to each other and the space they share.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a Senior Creative Lead who starts with the big question.

Before the space, before the technology, before any of it: what is this experience actually saying? What does this brand need to communicate, and what's the most compelling way to do that in a room, at an event, in a space someone walks into?

That's where this role begins. With a holistic communication concept a brand storytelling idea that gives a project its reason for being. From there, it translates into spatial decisions, interactive moments, technology choices. But those come second. The person we're looking for holds the full arc, from the strategic question down to the specific expression of it.

We would like you to think from brand strategy to communication to experiential execution. In practice, that means someone like this might challenge a client's underlying ambition, build a creative communication strategy for a launch, and define a high-level concept for how a space should behave all within the same project.

If your strongest work is brand campaign films or advertising concepts, this isn't the right role. If your interest lies in creating (spatial) brand experiences where you make people feel something, invite them to explore, make them wonder, then please read on.

Core responsibilities

Concept development: Lead the creative thinking on key projects from brief to concept. Write clear, strong debriefs that sharpen the question before anyone starts answering it. Develop brand storytelling ideas that are holistic not just a visual style, or just a content format, but an idea about what a brand experience should do and feel like and mean.

Creative direction across projects Translate concepts into creative direction for multi-disciplinary teams, spatial designers, creative technologists, motion designers, producers. Not by designing everything yourself, but by making sure the idea holds across every decision.

Client relationships Be the main creative voice with clients throughout a project. Present with clarity and conviction. Challenge briefs when they need challenging. Help clients understand the difference between an installation and an experience.

Team leadership Build and lead project teams, internal and freelance. Set creative standards, give useful feedback, create space for others to do good work. Lead by being present, specific and engaged —not a distant creative director.

New business contribution Contribute to pitches and proposals. Bring ideas to the table early in the process, when the thinking matters most.

What a concept means for us

We've learned to be specific about this because the word gets used to mean too many things.

A Concept In This Context Is Not

A sketch or a render
A visual identity direction
A campaign format or content type
A technology idea

A concept is a brand storytelling idea. It's the answer to the question: what is this experience about? The why. It can usually be expressed in a sentence or two. It generates decisions — about space, interaction, content, materiality, technology — rather than describing them.

The technology is a tool. The space is a medium. The concept is the reason any of it exists.

Your profile

8+ years of experience in creative roles within experiential, brand, or spatial work
A portfolio of idea-led projects where you can clearly articulate what the concept was, where it came from, and how it shaped the final work
Experience working across disciplines: spatial, digital, interactive, content
Comfortable at the strategic level able to read and challenge a brand brief, not just respond to it
Strong presenter and communicator, in rooms that matter
Experience leading teams and working with freelancers
Has worked with global brands in lifestyle, fashion, luxury, or sport
Based in or willing to relocate to Amsterdam or Paris

What we don't need more of

We've had talented people apply whose work is genuinely strong but in a different domain. To save everyone time:

This role is not well suited to people whose primary experience is in advertising, brand film, or content production. The thinking that makes someone good at a 30-second spot or a social campaign is different from what this role requires. Neither is better, they're just different.

What's missing, and what we're looking for, is someone who starts with an idea.

What success looks like

You bring a clear concept to every project, early one that the whole team can work from
Clients trust your creative judgment, not just your execution
The work feels like it has a point of view, not just a visual language
Teams you lead know what they're aiming at and why
You make the projects harder in the right ways, and easier in the wrong ones

Random Studio Diversity & Inclusion Statement

At Random Studio, we believe that an inclusive work environment and a diverse team are key to creating fresh and inspiring work. We’re looking for candidates who enrich our culture and challenge the status quo. We encourage everyone to bring their whole selves to work, and we strive to provide all candidates with an unbiased and accessible recruitment process. If you require assistance due to a disability when applying please let us know in your application so we can accommodate your needs.

jobs.description:
Creative Strategist (D2C / DTC) at NUTRICOOK — own every ad we run for a category-leading lifestyle kitchen appliance brand scaling its direct-to-consumer business.

Who we are

NutriCook is a leading home and kitchen appliance brand headquartered in Dubai, with a fast-growing D2C (DTC) business. We focus on healthy cooking: air fryers, pressure cookers, indoor grills, ovens, food prep and cookware.
We are a category leader across the Middle East, and in 2027 we launch into Europe, the UK, Southeast Asia and India. Our own direct-to-consumer channel is already a meaningful part of the business. Our objective is to multiply it, and creative is the single biggest lever we have.
We are a lean team. If you own something here, you genuinely own it.

Why this role exists

Our D2C business has a ceiling on it, and the ceiling is our ads. Not our product, not our traffic, not our agency's media buying. Our creative.
Too much of it is AI-generated and it looks like it. We don't produce enough of it. And nobody wakes up owning it. Look at what Caraway and IM8 put out: that is the bar. Ads built on a real insight about a real person, made properly, in enough volume to keep testing and keep winning.
You will not inherit a creative engine or a production setup. You are building it.

What this job is, and what it is not

·         You own the idea.
You decide what we say, to whom, and why it will make them stop and buy.
·         You direct, you do not edit.
You brief and manage creators and editors to produce the work.
·         You build the bench.
You find, brief and manage the creators, editors and freelancers who make the work.
·         You don't buy media.
Our agency runs the buying. You own what they run.
·         You don't make brand films.
This is direct response. Every ad has a job, and the job is to sell.
What you will do

·        Know our products and customers properly. Mine reviews, returns, support tickets and competitors' reviews for real objections and real moments of delight.
·        Build a hook library and a point of view on what we should say, backed by evidence, not taste.
·        Write tight briefs: hook, angle, objection, proof and format, before anything is shot.
·        Source, cast and direct UGC creators so the output is usable first time.
·        Ship a steady stream of genuinely new concepts, not recuts, and grow the active ad library to 200+.
·        Run structured tests with a stated hypothesis. Read hook rate, hold rate, CTR and CVR by creative. Kill fast, scale winners, build the next five variations.
·        Work with the agency on ROAS: they own the buying, you own the creative that makes it work.
·        Make sure landing pages deliver what the ad promises, and run simple CRO tests to lift conversion.

What we need from you

·        3+ years owning performance ad creative on Meta and TikTok for a D2C or DTC e-commerce brand, or at an agency serving them.
·        A portfolio of ads you personally conceived and briefed, with the insight, the test and the numbers behind them.
·        Hands-on experience briefing and directing UGC creators.
·        Fluency in creative performance data: hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CVR, cost per result. You can explain why an ad failed, not just that it did.
·        Strong writing: hooks, scripts, ad copy.
·        Proven volume: dozens of concepts a quarter, not a handful a year.
·        A bias for action. You chase the creator, fix the edit and get it live.

Nice to have

·        Home, kitchen, food or daily-use product experience
·        Smart use of AI tools as an accelerator, knowing where they stop being good enough
·        Arabic, or experience making creative for this region
·        Static and motion design literacy, enough to art-direct

This job is not for you if

·        Your ads have been made mostly by AI with light human direction.
·        You've run social content rather than direct-response ads for a DTC brand.
·        You need a creative director above you to decide the angle.
·        You brief an agency and leave them to it. Here you own the output, not the handover.

How we measure you

·         Yours alone:
new concepts shipped per month, active ad library on the path to 200+, hook and hold rate, CTR and CVR by creative, and win rate against control.
·         Shared with the agency:
ROAS and cost per acquisition.
·         The point of the role:
incremental D2C revenue growth.
What we offer

·        Full ownership of the creative behind a real, growing D2C business
·        A product people genuinely love, which makes the creative job easier and more fun
·        Real budget, real volume and direct access to leadership
·        Competitive salary, annual performance bonus, medical insurance, annual air ticket and UAE visa as per company policy

How to apply

2. Within 48 hours, email three ads you personally conceived and briefed to hr@caliberbrands.com with the subject line "My Best Ad". Links, files or screen recordings are fine. For one of them, tell us the insight, what you were trying to prove, what it spent and what it returned.

jobs.title: Specialist, Performance Marketing - instashop
jobs.description:
instashop, headquartered in Dubai, is the leading online local marketplace in the UAE and Egypt . Since joining the Delivery Hero family in 2020, the global leader in online food delivery and q-commerce, instashop has been setting the standard for excellence and convenience in the region.

With a dynamic and motivated team fueled by passion and innovation, every day at instashop is an opportunity for growth and success. We champion inclusivity, diversity and collaboration, creating an environment where everyone’s achievements are celebrated and where success is the only way forward. As we continue to grow, our team keeps expanding across the UAE, Egypt and Greece, and we’re always on the lookout for new talents to join us on our success journey.

Job Description

This is an individual contributor role on the Performance Marketing team. You will own the day-to-day execution of paid campaigns across channels, manage budgets, and drive customer acquisition for instashop.

You will work directly with the Head of Marketing at instashop on Marcomms strategy, incentive tracking, and business performance analysis, but also work as a dotted line with Talabat’s performance marketing lead. This is a hybrid role: part campaign executor, part strategic analyst. You need to be comfortable switching between both.

The team expects you to run lean. That means embedding AI into your workflow, cutting manual steps wherever possible, and operating at a pace that matches the business.

Campaign Execution

Own end-to-end campaign setup, bidding, and optimisation across Meta, TikTok, and other paid channels.
Take creatives live, test new formats, and iterate based on performance data.
Manage daily budget allocation and pacing to hit CAC targets.
Monitor campaign health and flag issues before they compound.

Performance Analysis

Analyse campaign performance across the full funnel, from impression to conversion.
Build and maintain regular performance reports for the Head of Marketing and senior stakeholders across the two main markets (UAE & Egypt)
Track incentive performance and contribute to business performance reviews.
Identify CAC efficiency opportunities and bring data-backed recommendations.

Experimentation

Design and run A/B tests on creatives, audiences, bids, and landing experiences.
Document test hypotheses, results, and learnings in a structured way.
Propose new experiments based on platform signals, competitive benchmarks, and your own analysis.

Strategy and Marcomms Collaboration

Work closely with the Head of Marketing at instashop on marketing communications planning and calendar.
Support incentive design and tracking, aligning promotional activity with acquisition goals.
Contribute to quarterly planning with performance data and channel insights.

Qualifications

Platform Depth

Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager: campaign structures, bidding strategies, Advantage+ campaigns, and creative best practices.
Working knowledge of TikTok Ads: smart campaigns, TopView, In-Feed, and short-form content performance patterns.
Familiarity with how short-form content (Reels, TikToks) behaves differently in paid vs organic and how to use that to brief or iterate on creative.
Working knowledge of other platforms such as Google, Apple Ads, Snapchat etc.
Understanding of attribution and MMP mechanics: how platforms like Adjust or AppsFlyer measure installs, events, and in-app revenue, and where discrepancies come from.

AI-First Way of Working

You are expected to use AI tools actively in your day-to-day: for reporting, analysis, brief writing, and workflow automation.
The goal is to reduce manual overhead, not just stay busy. If you are doing something repetitive that a well-prompted tool can do, you should already be automating it.
Comfort with prompt engineering and integrating AI outputs into real workflows is a strong plus.

Analytical Rigour

You can pull data, build a view, and explain what it means without being hand-held.
You understand incrementality vs. last-touch attribution, and you can have an informed conversation about channel contribution.
You know what CAC, LTV, ROAS, and CPM mean in practice, not just as definitions.

Speed and Ownership

You do not wait to be told what is wrong. You monitor, spot it, and fix it or flag it.
You manage your own workload across campaigns and strategic tasks without dropping either.
Fast-paced environment is not a cliche here. It is the actual pace of this team.

Qualifications

3 to 5 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, with at least 2 years focused on paid social.
Experience managing and allocating performance marketing budgets across channels and markets with the ability to optimize spend based business objectives.
Proven track record running Meta and TikTok campaigns, not just setting them up.
Experience working with MMPs (Adjust, AppsFlyer, or equivalent) and understanding attribution at a platform level.
Exposure to q-commerce, food delivery, or e-commerce is a strong plus.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.

Nice to Have

Experience running campaigns across both brand and performance objectives simultaneously.
Experience briefing creative teams and giving structured feedback on short-form video assets.
Hands-on use of AI tools in a marketing context (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar).

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Creative Strategist/ Art Director

Overview

The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that help our customers grow. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, this team provides consulting, marketing, loyalty and analytics to financial institutions and merchants globally. Marketing Services is the team within Services that develops and executes the marketing programs that help our clients achieve their marketing goals. The Advisors Creative Desk (ACD) sits within Services and is responsible for ideating and creating engaging, forward-thinking, on-brand content solutions and campaigns that connect our advertising partners, platforms, and our portfolio of brands.

As a Sr Creative Art based in Milan, you will shape the creative thinking and designs behind our work for the Italian market - turning client business challenges into sharp strategic platforms and bringing them creatively to life as ideas that can be seen, not just read. You will relish a fast-paced environment, juggle multiple deliverables, and be equally comfortable defending a strategic rationale and sketching out how the idea should look and feel.

The Role

Translate client briefs and market insight into compelling creative strategies and campaign platforms for the Italian market, with occasional work across wider Europe
Develop holistic, memorable campaigns from initial concept through to execution - Working closely with Creative Desk Project Managers, Art Directors and Copywriters to ensure end-to-end development and delivery of campaigns for assigned customers.
Maintain quality, accuracy and consistency of content and design across all mediums to best industry practice standards and client branding guidelines by ensuring all output is checked and errors minimised.
Overall responsibility for the production of communications material on time and to budget.
Bring strong conceptual skills and a highly developed ability to express those concepts across a continuously evolving set of channels
Craft short and long form copy in Italian and English for marketing purposes, including direct response designed to drive action and conversion
Think visually: shape look, feel, layout and tone alongside designers and art directors, and communicate ideas through sketches, mood boards, storyboards or scrappy mock-ups where words alone won't land
Execute across a wide array of channels including TV, online video, online banners, social platforms, and print - always to the highest standards of craft
Present work concisely in internal reviews and client meetings, in both Italian and English
Be proactive in bringing ideas that solve client challenges and grow the business

All About You

Native or fully fluent Italian, with proven experience building creative work for the Italian market and a genuine feel for its culture, media landscape and consumer behaviour
Fluent business English - you will work daily with colleagues and clients across Europe
Experience developing creative strategy and concepts within a creative agency environment or client-side marketing team
Ability to concept new campaigns across a variety of mediums, digital-first
Ability to combine conceptual creative thinking with high-quality delivery
A strong visual instinct - you have a point of view on design, typography and imagery
Ability to interpret brand and style guidelines from various clients and apply them consistently across marketing collateral
Ability to interpret creative briefing documents and translate them into compelling, on-strategy work
Captivating presentation skills
Passionate about social platforms, trends, technology and best practices
Excellent organizational and communication skills

A Plus

International or multi-market campaign experience
Experience in financial institutions, banking, payments or wider FI industries
Creative agency background
A solid understanding of the customer journey as it relates to card and banking (acquisition, conversion, activation, early month on books, customer loyalty, cross-sell)
A portfolio that shows both the thinking and the making - strategy decks alongside work you helped shape visually

Gross annual salary base range: 45,000 - 72,000 EUR

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Kurgu ritmi, sahne seçimi, geçişler, hareketli metinler, altyazı, renk uyumu ve ses dengesi konusunda iyi bir değerlendirme becerisine sahip olmak.

Farklı ekran oranlarına ve video sürelerine uyarlama yapabilmek; mobil okunabilirliği ve metinlerin ekran üzerindeki yerleşimini kontrol etmek.

Aynı ürün için farklı açılışlar, anlatımlar ve teklifler hazırlayabilmek; izlenme, tıklama ve dönüşüm verilerini pazarlama ekibiyle değerlendirerek kurguyu geliştirmek.

Proje oluşturma, mevcut kodu düzenleme, komut çalıştırma ve hata giderme süreçlerinde Claude Code’u etkin kullanabilmek; çıkan sonucu test ederek doğrulamak.

Remotion veya HyperFrames gibi araçlardan en az biriyle uygulamalı çalışma yapmış olmak; video talimatlarını sahne, zamanlama, metin ve animasyon düzenlemelerine dönüştürebilmek.
Üretken AI araçları:
Higgsfield, OpenArt veya benzeri platformlarla görsel ve video üretmiş olmak; referanslarla çalışabilmek ve üretilen materyalleri reklam kurgusunda değerlendirebilmek.
Yazılım temelleri:
Proje ve klasör yapısını anlayabilmek; terminal, Git, JSON ve temel kod okuma konusunda rahat olmak. AI’ın yazdığı kodu yalnızca çalıştırmak yerine ne yaptığını genel hatlarıyla açıklayabilmek.
Backend ve sistem mantığı:
Arayüz, backend, API, veri tabanı ve dosya depolamanın rollerini bilmek. Bir video talebinin alınması, işlenmesi, durumunun takip edilmesi ve çıktısının kullanıcıya sunulması arasındaki akışı anlayabilmek.
API ve otomasyon:
fal.ai gibi servislerle görsel/video üretim API’lerini kullanabilmek; istek gönderme, işlem durumunu takip etme ve sonucu alma adımlarını bir prototipe bağlayabilmek. fal

Gerçek çekimleri, ürün görsellerini ve AI ile oluşturulan sahneleri birleştirerek satış odaklı videolar hazırlamak.

Brief, ham görüntü ve ürün bilgilerinden hareketle sahne planı, altyazı, ses ve video çıktısı hazırlayan iş akışları kurmak.
Tekrar kullanılabilir şablonlar oluşturmak:
Ürün, metin, açılış, teklif veya dil değiştiğinde yeni video versiyonları üretebilen yapılar hazırlamak.
Çalışan prototipler geliştirmek:
Ekibin kullanabileceği basit bir panel veya araç üzerinden video talebi, ön izleme, revizyon ve çıktı alma süreçlerini tasarlamak.
Kalite ve operasyonu sahiplenmek:
AI çıktılarındaki görsel hataları, süreklilik sorunlarını ve ses–altyazı uyumsuzluklarını düzeltmek; üretim maliyetini, süresini ve başarısız işlemleri takip etmek.

Prototiplerin daha güvenilir ve daha fazla kullanıcıya hizmet verebilen ürünlere dönüşmesi için teknik ekiple birlikte ilerlemek.

Mutabor
ist die größte unabhängige internationale Markenagentur, die in Deutschland gegründet wurde. Die Inhaber, Johannes Plass und Heinrich Paravicini, sind bis heute Teil der 6-köpfigen Geschäftsführung.

Die Dienstleistungen umfassen u.a.: strategische Beratung, Gestaltung und adaptive Designsysteme inklusive Packaging, Live- und Digital Experience, Kommunikation sowie Brand Management.
Zu den Kund:innen gehören u.a. BMW-Motorrad, BRENNTAG, Clariant, GEA, die DFL, Henkel, HelleniQ Energy, Kleinanzeigen, Migros, OTTO, Pfizer, Porsche, Veltins und Volkswagen.

Mutabor ist der lateinische Ausdruck für den Willen zur Veränderung (ich werde verwandelt werden – i'm going to change). Dieser Wille treibt Mutabor seit der Gründung 1998 an. Mit über 700 Awards, unzähligen Projekten für Kund:innen fast aller Branchen – von Start-ups bis zu internationalen Konzernen – gehört Mutabor heute zu den größten unabhängigen Agenturen der Kreativbranche in Deutschland.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Senior Creative Strategist (f/m/d) bei Mutabor Advertising bist du die strategische Instanz im Team: Du entwickelst eigenverantwortlich Kampagnenstrategien und Markenpositionierungen, gibst der Kreation die richtigen Sprungbretter und bringst Kund:innen auf Entscheider:innen-Ebene klare strategische Orientierung. Du übernimmst Projekte von Anfang bis Ende - von der Analyse über die Konzeption bis zur Präsentation. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kreation und Beratung zusammen und wirkst punktuell auch bereichsübergreifend mit Expert:innen aus Brand Design, UX/UI Design, Motion Design und Architektur.
Du verantwortest und entwickelst eigenständig Kampagnenstrategien, Markenpositionierungen und zielgruppenspezifische Kommunikationsframeworks - von der Analyse bis zur Präsentation.

Du bringst dich aktiv in New-Business-Initiativen ein - von der Konzeption bis zur Präsentation.
Du behältst den Überblick über strategische Projektprozesse, sorgst für Transparenz gegenüber allen Stakeholder:innen und steuerst (Teil-)Projekte eigenverantwortlich.
Du treibst die Weiterentwicklung von Arbeitsmethoden, Tools und Prozessen im Strategiebereich voran und gibst dein Wissen an Kolleg:innen in deinem Team weiter.

Deine Qualifikationen

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. in Kommunikationswissenschaft, Marketing, BWL, Wirtschaftspsychologie oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer Kommunikations- oder Markenstrategie-Agentur mit.
Du hast nachweisliche Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Führung von Strategie-Projekten und im direkten Kund:innenkontakt.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, formulierst komplexe Inhalte klar und verständlich und erstellst überzeugende Präsentationen, die Wirkung entfalten.
Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Office – insbesondere PowerPoint – sowie Erfahrung mit strategischen Research-Tools wie Statista oder best4planning.
Du erkennst Potenziale frühzeitig, bringst proaktiv Impulse ein und gibst strategische Impulse sowohl nach innen als auch nach außen.
Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für (unterhaltsame) Werbung, kulturelle Trends und kommunikationswirksame Ideen.

Sei Teil der kreativsten Designagentur Deutschlands.
Hier findest du den Austausch und die Zusammenarbeit in einem interdisziplinären Team. Von Corporate Design, UX-UI-Design über Architektur bis hin zu Motion Design - für jeden Kopf finden wir den richtigen Hut.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist im E-Commerce 100% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du weißt, warum Werbung funktioniert... und warum nicht.

Du scrollst durch Deinen Feed und siehst sofort: dieser Hook zieht, dieser verliert nach zwei Sekunden . Du denkst in Angles, Zielgruppen-Psychologie und Conversion-Funneln und weißt, dass der Unterschied zwischen einem erfolgreichen Ad und einer Geldverbrennung oft eine einzige Eröffnungszeile ist.

Bei SHEKO bist du die Person, die unsere bezahlten Ads von „gut" auf „skalierbar" hebt.

Was SHEKO ist

Wir sind eine Hamburger Health & Nutrition Brand mit echter Fanbasis – von Meal Replacement Shakes über Multi Kollagen bis zu Probiotika. Unsere Kundinnen lieben uns nicht wegen eines Algorithmus, sondern weil unsere Produkte funktionieren und unsere Kommunikation ehrlich ist. Du findest uns bei dm, Rossmann und in tausenden Küchen.

Wir sind ein kleines, schnelles Team direkt am Produkt. Keine endlosen Freigaberunden, keine Agentur als Mittelsmann – Du baust, testest, lernst, iterierst.

Aufgaben

Als Senior Creative Strategist bist Du die Schnittstelle zwischen Daten, Psychologie und kreativer Idee und führst gleichzeitig unser 4-köpfiges Creative-Team. Du planst unsere Paid Ads auf Meta und TikTok – von der ersten strategischen Überlegung bis zum fertigen Brief für Konzept, Copy und Produktion.

Du bist verantwortlich für:

Teamlead:
Du führst unser Creative-Team aus 4 Personen – fachlich und disziplinarisch. Du entwickelst Deine Leute weiter, priorisierst die Creative-Pipeline und sorgst dafür, dass Qualität und Output stimmen

Creative Strategy:
Du entwickelst Angles, Hooks und Narratives für unsere Ads – basierend auf echten Kundeninsights, Wettbewerbsanalyse und Performance-Daten

Briefing
: Du schreibst präzise, inspirierende Briefs für unser Creative- und Video-Team sowie externe UGC Creator

Testing & Iteration
: Du baust strukturierte Creative-Test-Frameworks auf, wertest aus, was performt und weißt, warum

Skripte & Copy
: Du entwickelst Skripte für UGC-Videos, Static Ads und Carousels; Du hast ein Gespür für Direct Response und Storytelling zugleich

Markt- & Zielgruppenanalyse
: Du kennst unsere Zielgruppen besser als sie sich selbst kennen – und übersetzt das in kreative Konzepte

Enge Zusammenarbeit
mit Media Buying, Art Direction und Produktmarketing

Qualifikation

Must-haves:

3–5 Jahre Erfahrung in Creative Strategy, Performance Marketing oder Paid Social – idealerweise in einer D2C Brand oder E-Commerce-fokussierten Agentur

Nachweisliche Erfahrung mit Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram); TikTok Ads ein Plus

Du kannst Ad-Performance-Daten lesen und in konkrete kreative Entscheidungen übersetzen

Starke schriftliche Ausdrucksfähigkeit auf Deutsch – Du schreibst Hooks, die hängen bleiben

Verständnis von Käuferpsychologie: Hooks, Pain Points, Benefits, Social Proof

Nice-to-haves:

Erfahrung im Bereich Health, Beauty oder FMCG

Kenntnisse in Tools wie Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, Foreplay, Atria oder ähnlichen Creative Intelligence Tools

Grundverständnis von A/B-Testing und statistischer Signifikanz

Benefits

Echte Gestaltungsfreiheit:
Flache Hierarchien, offene Feedback-Kultur und die Möglichkeit, ein wachsendes Unternehmen aktiv mitzuprägen

Persönliche Entwicklung:
Wir entwickeln gemeinsam Karriereziele, die zu Dir passen – fachlich wie persönlich

Starkes Team:
Hands-On-Mentalität, enormer Zusammenhalt und eine Kultur, in der gegenseitige Unterstützung selbstverständlich ist

Modernes Office:
Wohlfühlfaktor in Hamburg-Winterhude, zentral am schönen Mühlenkamp in Alsternähe. Dresscode? Komm wie Du Dich am wohlsten fühlst

Die Basics:
Wasser, Tee, Kaffee & Shake-Flat, regelmäßige Team-Events und legendäre Firmenpartys

Klingt nach Dir? Dann schick uns neben Deinem Lebenslauf zwei bis drei Beispiele für Ads, Hooks oder Briefs
, auf die Du stolz bist und kurz, warum sie funktioniert haben (oder was Du heute anders machen würdest).

Wir freuen uns besonders auf Bewerbungen von Leuten, die selbst gern online kaufen, Zutaten auf Produkten lesen und wissen, was einen guten Hook von einem großartigen unterscheidet.

jobs.title: Senior Creative
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Authentic Brands Group (Authentic) is a global brand and entertainment platform that owns and invests in iconic intellectual property and cultural assets. It accelerates brands through a set of specialized businesses that combine powerful storytelling, premium content, unforgettable live experiences and global commerce. Through a network of more than 1,700 best-in-class licensees and strategic partners across 150 countries and expansive distribution, Authentic’s brands drive more than $38 billion in annual systemwide retail sales worldwide. Authentic’s diversified portfolio spans more than 50 brands and reaches nearly one billion social media followers. Its roster includes Reebok, Champion, Shaquille O’Neal, David Beckham, Kevin Hart, Sports Illustrated, Elvis Presley, Muhammad Ali, Marilyn Monroe, GUESS, Aéropostale, Nautica, Eddie Bauer, Lucky Brand, Nine West, Brooks Brothers, Juicy Couture, Vince Camuto, Izod, Van Heusen, Dockers, Ted Baker, Hart Schaffner Marx, Vince, Barneys New York, Judith Leiber, Quiksilver, Spyder, Billabong, Volcom, Roxy, RVCA, DC Shoes, Prince, Sperry and Hunter. For more information, visit corporate.authentic.com. Follow Authentic on LinkedIn, Instagram and WeChat.
Why Authentic

You’ll be able to access the resources and scale, while leveraging innovative technology and nimble environment. What we’re saying is, this isn’t your average day job. If you’re hungry to drive ideas into action and own your career, let’s chat. Our team is rapidly innovating to evolve and define the future of our brands. With the help of some of the brightest minds in retail, marketing, licensing, legal and more, we are building the intersection of digital and experiential marketing to help achieve that mission. We reimagine, evolve and transform brands! At Authentic, we foster an inclusive workplace where diversity of thought and expertise drive competitive advantage. Our global teams are built by go-getters who contribute unique perspectives and push the boundaries of creativity and innovation. Headquartered in New York City, Authentic has offices in major metropolitan cities including Los Angeles and Miami, as well as Toronto, Mexico City, London, and Shanghai.
  What You’ll Do

We are looking for an experienced Senior Creative to support the ideation, production and delivery of creative assets across all activities, products and partnerships associated with the David Beckham brand.
The role will work closely with Authentic’s VP, Creative Director, acting as a key creative partner. You will help shape creative direction, develop ideas and oversee the delivery of high-quality content across social, digital, editorial, campaigns and brand partner channels.
A key part of the role will be taking ownership of the day-to-day creative process, ensuring work is delivered to the highest standard and in line with the David Beckham brand. You will be confident stepping up to lead projects, provide creative direction and represent the creative function when the VP, Creative Director is unavailable.
The role requires a keen eye for detail and strong aesthetic appreciation. The range of brand partnerships spans fashion, sport, automotive, philanthropic and lifestyle, with each requiring a unique sensibility and approach. Across every partnership, the highest level of care and attention is required, with every asset viewed on a global stage.
From social-first content to ATL campaigns, the level of creative ambition and attention to detail remains consistent, maintaining a best-in-class creative aesthetic across all output.
The role will help manage and evolve the creative process, fostering strong collaboration across internal teams, commercial partners, production teams, editorial and external creative talent. This encompasses digital, social, print, moving image, stills and product.
This is an opportunity for a highly capable senior creative to play a central role within a dynamic, creative and entrepreneurial environment, working across a diverse portfolio of global opportunities.
What You’ll Be Working On

Partner closely with the VP, Creative Director to develop and deliver the overall creative vision for the David Beckham brand and its partnerships, deputising and taking creative ownership where required.
Lead day-to-day creative development and execution across campaigns, social, editorial, digital, film, photography and commercial partnerships.
Maintain a best-in-class creative standard, facilitating ideation and content creation internally and externally, ensuring consistency, quality and continued elevation of the David Beckham brand.
Provide creative direction across look and feel, art direction, retouching and overall content output, working closely with a variety of production/ creative agencies and in-house creative brand partners.
Work closely with the Brand Partnerships team to shape concepts for social media and commercial campaigns, translating ideas into effective 360° creative executions.
Take ownership of projects from brief through to execution, ensuring creative quality, timelines and partner requirements are effectively managed.
Provide creative leadership and direction to internal teams and external creative partners, helping to get the best from multidisciplinary teams and high-profile talent.
Contribute creative thinking to new business development and partnership opportunities.
Oversee design output, including client presentations, and ensure effective organisation and filing of creative assets.
Build and maintain a network of high-level creative talent, including directors/ photographers/ editors, scriptwriters, DOPs and other creative specialists, bringing fresh thinking and expertise into the business.
Stay ahead of current and emerging trends across photography, fashion, lifestyle, film and social media, bringing relevant global perspectives and new approaches into the work.

Must Haves

8-10 years’ experience in a Senior Creative or similar role.
Strong experience in art direction within an advertising or creative agency, with high-level editorial experience across fashion, sport and/or lifestyle.
A highly creative thinker with the ability to generate, develop and articulate strong ideas.
Ability to shape creative concepts around brand and partner objectives, existing brand DNA, audience, cultural context and emerging trends.
Proven ability to lead creative projects from brief through to execution, with strong knowledge of creative references, research and trends.
Strong aesthetic judgement and an elevated visual point of view, with a passion for exceptional creative output.
Experience leading and collaborating with multidisciplinary creative teams and high-profile talent.
Strong experience across social media, film, photography, scripts and broader content production.
Good level of image retouching and video editing skills.
Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume content environment, particularly across social and digital.
Confident stepping into a leadership role, providing creative direction and deputising for senior creative leadership when required.
Able to get things done quickly in a dynamic/entrepreneurial environment.
Technical proficiency in design applications / BA or equivalent in Graphic Design / Adobe Creative Suite / Keynote.
Time management skills / Attention to detail / well organised.

Fraud Alert: Unauthorized Job Offers and Impersonations

We have been made aware of fraudulent job offers and interview requests being sent by individuals falsely claiming to represent Authentic. These scams are often initiated via email, employment websites and social media, and may include fake interview requests, offer letters or attempts to collect personal and financial information.
Please note:
All legitimate Authentic job postings can be found only on our official website (authentic.com) or through our verified LinkedIn page (https://www.linkedin.com/company/weareauthentic).
Authentic does not conduct interviews over Teams or Zoom without prior email correspondence from a verified @authentic.com email address.
We will never ask you for sensitive personal information, payment or banking details as part of the hiring process.

If you believe you've been contacted by someone impersonating an Authentic team member, please report it immediately by emailing peopleandculture@authentic.com.
Authentic is an equal-opportunity employer and we value and embrace the diversity and inclusion of all Team Members. We do not discriminate on the basis of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, national origin, disability, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or other legally protected status.

For individuals with disabilities or religious obligations who would like to request an accommodation, please contact
talent@authentic.com

United Racing Şans Oyunları A.Ş. has become authorized provider giving service to operate horse race betting, with the rights and powers to accept bets on horse races in Türkiye, organized both in Türkiye and abroad, effective as of 1 January 2026, pursuant to a 10-year agreement concluded with Türkiye Wealth Fund A.Ş.

As we continue to accelerate the digital growth of ebayi.org
, we are looking for a committed, analytical, and technology-oriented Growth Marketing Senior Specialist
to join our Marketing team.

This role offers the opportunity to drive customer acquisition, optimize digital performance, leverage data-driven decision-making, and contribute to the long-term growth of one of Türkiye's most exciting digital betting platforms.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Management Information Systems, or a related field.
Minimum 3-4 years of hands-on experience in Growth Marketing or a similar role within e-commerce, performance marketing agencies, or the betting industry.
Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.
Proven experience managing paid social media and digital performance campaigns.
Practical knowledge of Google Analytics 4, Firebase, Adjust, and Google Tag Manager.
Experience with campaign tracking, conversion measurement, attribution models, UTM structures, event-based analytics, and performance reporting.
Good understanding of SEO and ASO principles.
Experience in e-commerce campaign management, conversion funnels, customer journeys, and performance optimization.
Experience working with creative, media, digital, or performance marketing agencies.
Ability to manage multiple campaigns, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.
Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to transform campaign and customer data into meaningful business insights and actionable recommendations.
Familiarity with AI-powered tools used for digital marketing, reporting, creative production, analytics, and optimization.
Knowledge of Looker Studio, BigQuery, CRM platforms, marketing automation, or customer engagement platforms.
Experience in app marketing, mobile attribution, deep linking, remarketing, and lifecycle marketing is considered an advantage.
Good command of written and spoken English.

Key Responsibilities

Plan, execute, manage, and optimize performance marketing campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Programmatic, TikTok Ads, and other relevant digital advertising platforms.
Develop acquisition and conversion strategies for both web and mobile audiences.
Manage campaign budgets, bidding strategies, audience targeting, remarketing activities, creative testing, and optimization processes.
Coordinate digital campaigns, promotional periods, product launches, and special event communications for ebayi.org.
Prepare creative briefs and coordinate campaign asset development with external creative and media agencies.

Collaborate closely with Product and Technology teams to manage landing pages, campaign mechanics, deep links, event tracking, and conversion journeys.
Utilize Google Analytics 4, Firebase, Adjust, Google Tag Manager, and other growth marketing tools to monitor campaign and customer performance.
Create and maintain dashboards and reports covering acquisition, traffic, engagement, conversion, attribution, and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
Identify tracking gaps and coordinate improvements in analytics and measurement infrastructure.
Manage and support SEO and ASO initiatives to improve organic traffic, app visibility, keyword rankings, and app store conversion rates.
Conduct A/B testing across audiences, creatives, campaign messaging, landing pages, and customer journeys.
Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable recommendations to improve business results.
Stay up to date with developments across Google, Meta, mobile measurement, marketing automation, and AI-powered marketing technologies.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive marketing processes and improve campaign management, reporting, and creative production.
Monitor competitor activities, digital trends, and emerging growth opportunities.

jobs.title: Creative Director, Fundraising and Mobilization (Evergreen)
jobs.description:
Interested in joining Blue State's Creative Director team? Submit your application here to ensure you're first in line for future opportunities. Please note: this is an "evergreen" job post (i.e. not an active job post), but your expression of interest matters to us. While interviews aren't ongoing, we're excited to connect with talented individuals who share our commitment to Blue State's mission.

If you came across this job via LinkedIn, please note that it is an evergreen role; Linked In does not differentiate, but we prefer to.

What to know

Create compelling campaigns, brands and experiences for causes that matter. In this role, you will work closely with account directors, strategists, designers, writers and analysts to ensure that we’re delivering innovative, beautiful and flawless work that exceeds the expectations of the organisations we work with. You will bring creative vision and impactful leadership to nonprofits, advocacy campaigns and brands’ social impact teams.

We believe great creative is data and strategy driven, not ego-driven. We’re looking for you to collaborate closely with our teams to shape test-worthy ideas that will let the numbers do the talking.

We’re interested in the originality, honesty and proven success of your concepts and appeals.

The company

Blue State is a purpose-driven agency. We partner with leading causes, brands, and campaigns and create real change. From AARP and Doctors Without Borders to Amnesty International and Oxfam, we transform how brands and causes raise money, influence policy, build platforms, and grow communities of supporters. Led by the most creative and analytical minds from the political, nonprofit, and brand worlds, Blue State is an independent agency in the US and London.

A day in the life

Lead and inspire:
Working closely with your colleagues, you’ll develop a vision for our client’s creative success. You’ll guide the development and implementation of campaigns, appeals and creative platforms, from initial presentations through final delivery.
Create with purpose:
Organisations come to us with big questions and for direction on how to be more meaningful, relevant and human - your conceptual thinking and messaging will help make that a reality.
Accountability:
Assess and ensure the quality of creative process and product on an ongoing basis. Attend internal critiques, and provide creative solutions to team. Final sign-off on design, copy, and UX work for key projects.
Foster a culture of collaboration and creativity:
Stay on top of developments in the field, industry, and culture. Help identify, hire and retain designers, copywriters, and other creatives. Mentor junior members of the project team.

What we offer

Unlimited time off (inclusive of sick, personal and vacation days)
$1,000 annual in professional development funds (local equivalent)
Fully subsidised health and dental insurance for employees (subject to tax)
Generous pension match via salary sacrifice
Generous paid holiday schedule
Parental leave policy for up to 32.5 week of coverage at full pay, inclusive of all genders and supporting a range of family structures
Group Income Protection (GIP)
Group Life Assurance (GLA)
Optional holiday travel insurance
Pre-tax season ticket loans
Cycle to work (up to £2000)
Remote work flexibility

We approach in-office working with a hybrid model, with presence in our office required at two days per week.

The team

You’ll be a senior member of the London team bringing in new clients and, as a leader, defining and improving the work we’re creating. You will also be a part of our global creative director team who meet regularly for creative inspiration.

Some things we're looking for

6+ years in senior creative role, ideally with hands-on designing experience. At least some of this experience working on fundraising and mobilisation campaigns.
Experience in leading and collaborating with teams of designers, copywriters, strategists and creatives - taking insight that has been shaped and developing compelling, digitally-driven ideas and products.
Strategy-led: able to clearly articulate design or strategy related dilemmas, and offer multiple solutions with a clear link back to the strategy and insights.
Comfort and passion for creative testing, co-creation with clients and audiences, and constructively consolidating feedback from global stakeholders to improve the work.
Impeccable presentation skills: able to explain the reasons behind a particular design or creative strategy, and guide clients through difficult decision points. Experience in pitching a strong advantage.
Deep knowledge of persuasion strategies & tools: copywriting, social influence, brand advocacy, fundraising, UX and experience design.
Strong sense of communications and its operating model: how impactful messages are created, journeys constructed and users driven on a journey from awareness to advocacy.
An area of expertise or passion in the design world (be it fundraising, design, UX, communications or social change) that you can harness and upskill wider team members with as a thought leader within the wider company.
Industry-leading quality of work: you produce inspiring work that stands out, is flawless in execution, and innovative in thought. You are both a doer and a thinker, and your work reflects that.
Patient with your colleagues and clients, able to make key decisions when and where required.
Ability to adapt to new situations, solve problems on the fly, and communicate with those around you. Teamwork and scrappiness required, alongside respect to our clients and their expertise.
A shared passion and curiosity for making change. This includes comfort with ambiguity, a restlessness that resists the status quo, and a commitment to quality that ensures we’re always making progress.
A firm grasp on the latest AI tools, the creative and ethical considerations they demand, and a healthy disrelish for written and visual slop.
Empathy, communication, respect, and the ability to act as a role model at Blue State.

At Blue State, diversity is a necessity, not a nice-to-have. We encourage those from underrepresented communities — women, people of color, LGBTQIA+, immigrants, those with disabilities and people at all the intersections in between — to apply. Even if you don’t think your current skill set checks every box, but this role seems to align with your strengths, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: DODO Senior Art Director
jobs.description:
**Summary**

Founded in Milan in 1994, DoDo was the first luxury brand to offer "talking charms"—jewels that combine playful storytelling with deep emotional meaning. As part of the Kering Group, we are a pioneer in sustainability, being one of the first jewelers to use responsible gold in all our creations. Our mission is to champion inclusivity, self-expression, and environmental protection.

**Job Description**

**Role Purpose**

As a Senior Art Director, you will play a key role in shaping and evolving DoDo’s visual identity across all brand touchpoints, taking ownership of creative projects from initial concept to final execution. You will be responsible for developing compelling and distinctive visual directions that strengthen the brand’s identity, storytelling, positioning, and desirability within the luxury jewelry landscape.

The Senior Art Director will report to the Head of Image and Creative Production and will work closely also with the Creative Director and cross-functional teams. The role will lead multiple creative projects simultaneously, balancing different priorities, timelines, and stakeholders while ensuring a consistently high level of creative quality. You will contribute to the definition of creative strategies, identify relevant cultural and visual opportunities, and translate insights and research into innovative creative concepts across campaigns, digital platforms, content productions, and brand communications.

The role requires a strong understanding of the luxury, jewelry, fashion and lifestyle industries, combined with a highly developed visual culture, curiosity, and the ability to proactively bring new references, ideas, and creative perspectives to the brand.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the development and execution of creative concepts and visual directions across campaigns, digital platforms, brand activations, content productions, and brand communications, from briefing to final delivery.
* Translate brand objectives and strategic briefs into strong, distinctive, and consistent visual concepts that reflect DoDo’s identity and positioning.
* Develop and present creative concepts, mood boards, visual territories, treatments, storyboards, and art direction proposals, clearly articulating the creative rationale behind each project.

* Develop and oversee the creative execution of photoshoots, content productions, and other creative projects, translating the overall creative direction into compelling visual outcomes and collaborating with photographers, filmmakers, stylists, set designers, agencies, and other external creative partners.

* Manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously, maintaining a high level of creative quality while meeting deadlines, budgets, and production requirements.
* Conduct ongoing creative, cultural, and industry research, identifying emerging trends, visual languages, cultural movements, artists, photographers, designers, and relevant references that can inform and evolve the brand’s creative expression.
* Review and refine creative work throughout the development process, maintaining high standards of execution, craftsmanship, and attention to detail.
* Support the Head of Image and Creative Production and the Creative Director in defining and evolving the brand’s broader visual language and creative direction.
* Manage presentations and creative reviews with internal stakeholders and external partners, effectively communicating creative ideas and securing alignment.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of brand guidelines and creative standards across markets and channels.
  

  

**Profile & Requirements**

* 6–8 years of professional experience in Art Direction, Creative Direction, Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related creative role, preferably within luxury, fashion, jewelry, lifestyle, or premium brands.
* Proven experience in leading creative projects from concept to execution, with a strong portfolio demonstrating a distinctive visual point of view.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing effectively across different levels of complexity, deadlines, stakeholders, and creative requirements.
* Strong creative research skills and the ability to translate cultural, visual, and industry insights into original creative concepts and relevant visual directions.
* Ability to develop a creative idea from a strategic brief and translate it into a coherent visual language across multiple channels and touchpoints.
* Strong experience on photoshoots and content production, with the ability to direct and collaborate effectively with photographers, filmmakers, stylists, agencies, and production partners.
* High level of autonomy, ownership, and accountability, a consistent commitment to delivering high-quality, refined, and brand-relevant creative work.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign); knowledge of motion design, video editing, and other creative software is considered a plus.
* Collaborative and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to work effectively across functions while maintaining a clear and confident creative point of view.
* Fluent in Italian and English; knowledge of another language is considered a plus.
  

**What we offer**

* Applicable CCNL: Goldsmiths, Silversmiths, and Jewelry Industry
* Indicative starting compensation: 50000€
* Eligibility to sales incentives as per company policy
* Benefits: in addition to those provided under the applicable National Collective Labor Agreement and by law, further benefits and initiatives are offered in accordance with company policies.
* Note on equal opportunities and non-discrimination: Kering is committed to diversity and inclusion and to providing equal opportunities in employment. We believe diversity in all its forms – disability, age, color, ancestry, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, gender identity

jobs.title: Senior UA Creative Strategist - Mobile Games
jobs.description:
The Role

We are looking for a sharp, highly curious UA Creative Strategist to help us decide what advertising creatives we should make and why.

This is not primarily a video editing or art production role. Your job is to stay ahead of the mobile games advertising market, spot emerging creative opportunities, understand what is working and what is becoming stale, and turn those insights into strong concepts and clear production briefs.

You will sit at the intersection of creative, user acquisition, games and data.

We want someone who watches the market closely, studies competitors, understands internet culture and short-form video, experiments aggressively, and is constantly asking:

“What should we test next?”

You will work with our UA team and with internal and external creators, editors, artists, AI tools and production partners to turn those ideas into ads.

What You’ll Do

Own Our UA Creative Direction

  • Develop a continuous pipeline of new video ad concepts, hooks, formats and creative hypotheses.
  • Decide which ideas are worth producing and testing based on market trends, player psychology, competitor activity and our own performance data.
  • Build a weekly creative roadmap rather than waiting for production requests.
  • Push beyond obvious variations of existing ads and actively search for new creative angles.

Hunt for Trends and Creative Opportunities

  • Constantly research mobile game advertising across TikTok, Meta, YouTube, AppLovin, Google, Unity, Mintegral and emerging channels.
  • Study successful ads from both direct competitors and completely different genres and industries.
  • Deconstruct winning creatives by looking at the hook, pacing, storytelling structure, gameplay, visual treatment, sound, creator style, emotional trigger and CTA.
  • Track broader TikTok, Reels, Shorts, creator and internet culture trends and identify which ones can be translated into performance advertising.
  • Maintain a living library of interesting ads, formats, hooks and creative patterns.

Turn Insights Into Things We Can Actually Make

  • Write clear, production-ready creative briefs, scripts, storyboards and references.
  • Explain not just what to make, but the hypothesis behind the idea and what we are trying to learn.
  • Give strong creative direction and feedback to video editors, motion designers, game capture teams, UGC creators, AI creators and external agencies.
  • Help producers and artists understand the intent of a concept without prescribing every frame.
  • Review work in progress and push execution until the original creative idea comes through clearly.

Build a Modern Creative Testing Machine

  • Work closely with UA managers to understand CTR, IPM, CVR, CPI, ROAS, retention and other creative performance signals.
  • Identify why a creative worked rather than simply declaring it a winner.
  • Turn winning ads into structured families of new hypotheses rather than endless minor variations.
  • Kill weak directions quickly and double down aggressively when a concept shows promise.
  • Watch for creative fatigue and ensure the pipeline always has genuinely fresh ideas entering testing.

Use AI Aggressively, but Intelligently

  • Stay current with AI image, video, voice, scripting and editing tools.
  • Use AI to prototype ideas, explore concepts and generate variations rapidly.
  • Understand where AI production is good enough, where human production is better, and when the two should be combined.
  • Experiment with AI-native formats and workflows rather than treating AI only as a cheaper production tool.
  • Help us continuously evaluate new creative tools, platforms and production partners.

jobs.title: Creative Strategist & Producer - Consumer
jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

The opportunity

Great creative starts with a sharp idea, and the earlier it arrives, the better the work gets. As our Creative Strategist & Producer, you bring ideas in at the start of a campaign and you can also make them. Up to half the role is writing complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, and sometimes organic and social, then briefing them into our creatives and designers. The other half is making work yourself, in whatever format you’re strongest at. You also help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing write stronger briefs of their own.

This role is for a proactive self-starter. Nobody will hand you the idea: you go and find it, pitch it and get it made.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You work daily with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, who bring deep knowledge of the product and the media channels, and with the creatives who bring your briefs to life.

Spot opportunities in culture every day. Watch pop culture, trends, competitors, comments and performance data, and turn what you find into ideas we ship the same week. Stay close to financial markets and to Kraken’s audience.
Write complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, built with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, and brief them into the performance creatives and designers.
Help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing managers sharpen their own briefs, bringing the concept, the hook and the cultural angle to the start of the process.
Pitch original concepts for paid and social before anyone asks, so ideas reach the team already sharp.
Make your own content for paid and organic. The format is open: you could be a meme machine, an AI video specialist, someone who performs to camera, or something we haven’t thought of. What matters is that it feels native to the feed and ships fast.
Use performance data and social listening as creative input, and get more distinct angles into tests each month.Performance Marketing owns test design and readouts; you own the creative response.
React inside the news cycle. You spot the moment, and you brief it or make it yourself.
Partner with Product Marketing and compliance to get work approved without losing the idea.
Keep your briefs and files clean enough for other people to build on.

What You Bring

5+ years in creative strategy, social, content or performance creative at a high-volume in-house team, brand or agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.
A portfolio submitted with your application. Include two or three concept-led briefs or concept decks, with what shipped and how it performed where you’re able to share it, plus work you made yourself in the formats that are your strength. Include one idea you spotted in culture or data and took to market, with a short note on what the results told you and what you changed.
A proactive, self-starting way of working. You find the idea, pitch it and drive it to be shipped without waiting to be asked, and you’re comfortable owning your workflow with light direction.
Pop-culture fluency and a chronically online persona, with comedic instinct and a sense for what’s about to feel dated.
A performance marketer’s grip on what a good brief needs: a clear objective, audience, hook, platform, format and set of constraints, and the ability to coach others toward it.
A creative superpower you can execute on alone, with shipped work to show for it.
Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and X. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.
Fluency in the metrics creative moves, and the habit of using performance data and social listening as inputs to ideas.
A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.
Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with concepts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.
Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. A rich showcase of integrated, multi-market campaign work, proving your ability to deliver high-concept ideas across digital, social, and traditional channels.
Experience across modern design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma), paired with an eagerness to explore new creative tech and generative visual tools to enhance output.
Clear, persuasive presentation skills with a track record of building trust with senior, global stakeholders.

LADbible Group is one of the world’s most engaged digital entertainment businesses, reaching over a billion people globally and amassing more than 13.9 billion social views each month. With a powerhouse portfolio across general lifestyle, entertainment, sport, gaming, and tech, our brands include LADbible, SPORTbible and Betches.

LADbible’s Commercial Team, LAD360, is a powerhouse of creativity, strategy, and innovation - partnering with the world’s most iconic brands, from Google and Nike to Disney and Tesco. With a headcount of 150 and growing, LAD360 has rapidly become one of the most formidable forces in media, delivering culture-shaping campaigns. Our work has earned us top industry accolades, including Commercial Team of the Year at the 2025 Campaign UK Awards
and Media Brand of the Year at the 2024 MediaWeek Awards
. At the heart of it all is a relentless drive to push boundaries, tell bold stories, and connect brands to youth culture like no one else can.

About the Role

Due to continued business growth and wins, we are expanding the Creative team even further! We’re looking for a conceptual Senior Creative to lead the creative ideation, strategy and execution for our branded pitches and campaigns. It’s an opportunity that requires excellent creative skills and an in-depth understanding of youth culture to be able to run the process from end to end, whilst also demonstrating commercial awareness and our ways of working at LADbible Group.

What the opportunity looks like

Lead projects from briefing to delivery, working with the rest of the creative team
Develop strong social-first ideas and challenge briefs and strategies where necessary
Be a content specialist, understanding the roles and production constraints of different content types (especially video) on social platforms
Specialise in social-led activations but be familiar with creating integrated campaigns, with an understanding of how to use everything from OOH to experiential in your campaign strategies
Communicate and champion creative thinking and technical execution to clients throughout each project
Oversee junior project teams to help them deliver their best work
Be a detail-oriented senior when it comes to approving work with overall accountability
Understand how to brief craft specialists: Animators, Designers, Directors, Talent etc. to deliver projects against your creative vision

Skills and experience we’d like you to have

Senior level creative experience in a social-led creative, marketing or advertising environment
Practical craft skills as well as conceptual thinking
Experience in a fast-paced, quick turnaround environment
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Understanding of how budgets work, scope of work and realistic deliverables
Deep understanding of the role that video/social content plays in every project
Proven track record delivering creatively and commercially successful projects
Experience overseeing teams
Interest in youth culture, pop cultures and social good
Ability to design pitch presentations in Keynote, PowerPoint, Google slides etc.

At LADbible Group we've rolled out blended working which means the majority of departments across the business (including London, Manchester and International offices) work in the office 4 days per week.

LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us. As the leading social youth publisher, we have a powerful global platform to better represent our audience and enable those that do not have equal opportunities to have their voices heard. As a business, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce, in an environment where everyone feels comfortable to be themselves.

jobs.description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

WPP steht für kreative Transformation. Mit der Kraft von Kreativität gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen für grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.

Das Bieten Wir Dir

Work-Life-Balance: Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem persönlichen Austausch im Office und ergänzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.
Vacation mode on: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.
Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.
Practice makes perfect: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.
More than just a job: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.
Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.

Das Bewegst Du

Als Creative Concepter & Strategist mit Fokus Influencer & Organic Social
bist du unser kreativer Kopf und strategischer Impulsgeber. Du übernimmst die inhaltliche Führung bei der Entwicklung von Creator-getriebenen Konzepten & Strategien

Deine Mission: Kreative Exzellenz mit Influencer- & Social-DNA!

Synergie aus Influence & Media: Dein Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung kulturell relevanter Kampagnen und Plattform-Konzepte. Du verbindest packendes Creator-Storytelling mit strategischer Mediaplanung und stehst im engen Austausch mit deinen Kolleg:innen aus der Media und dem Influencer Management.
Konzeption & Strategie: Von der ersten Trend-Idee über das Creator-Briefing bis hin zum fertigen Organic-Social-Format – du übernimmst die konzeptionelle und strategische Führung deiner Projekte und sorgst für Konsistenz und Exzellenz im Output.
Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit Expert:innen aus Social Media, Influencer Marketing, Brand Experience und Media, um ganzheitliche und wirkungsvolle Brand-Erlebnisse zu schaffen.
Kunden, Pitches & Storytelling: Du begleitest Kundenprojekte strategisch, arbeitest eng mit dem Projektmanagement zusammen und präsentierst deine Ideen & Strategien souverän bei Pitches, Workshops und Kundenterminen.
Mentoring & Team-Spirit: Du teilst dein Wissen rund um Creator Culture, Trends und Social Strategy proaktiv mit unseren Talenten – von Mid-Level bis zu Werkstudierenden – und entwickelst das Team gemeinsam weiter.

Das Zeichnet Dich Aus

Trend- & Creator-Gespür: Du lebst Social Media (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube & Co.), verstehst Creator-Culture sowie Plattform-Mechaniken im Schlaf und hast Lust, KI-Tools und neue Formate aktiv auszuprobieren.
Deine Erfahrung: Ideal sind 2–5 Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Influencer Marketing, Social Strategy, Konzeption oder Copywriting (bevorzugt im Agenturumfeld). Du weißt, wie man Stories schreibt, die sowohl Creators als auch Zielgruppen begeistern, und bringst idealerweise auch Dreherfahrung mit.
Dein Mindset: Du bist eigeninitiativ, strategisch denkend, verantwortungsbewusst und arbeitest lösungsorientiert mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.
Deine Skills: Du präsentierst und argumentierst stark auf Deutsch (mind. C1) sowie sehr gut auf Englisch.

Darüber hinaus bist du: #teamplayer #motiviert #neugierig

Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

Arbeiten Bei WPP Media

Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.

WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.
