jobs.description:
Location: Barcelona

About Us

We are Dragons, a global creative agency working with bold brands to build cultural relevance, connection, and long-term impact through strategy-led creativity.
We bridge digital and creative thinking, developing innovative work across skincare, healthcare, fashion, lifestyle, FMCG, and more. Our international teams in the US and Barcelona deliver results through smart strategy, sharp creativity, and meticulous execution.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Creative Director with strong conceptual thinking, great visual taste and experience working across global wellness and lifestyle brands.
Someone who can move comfortably between product and lifestyle, science and culture, and who understands how creative needs to work across the full consumer journey.
You might be working on a product with a complex ingredient or efficacy story one day, developing a talent-led campaign the next, and figuring out how that same brand idea translates into more product-focused or conversion-driven work further down the funnel.
This is a global role, so we’re looking for someone who is comfortable developing ideas that can travel across markets and cultures without becoming generic.
You’ll lead creative development across global wellness, beauty-adjacent and lifestyle brands, from early concepts and campaign platforms through to production and execution.
We’re looking for someone who cares about the idea as much as the craft, but also understands what the creative is there to do.
You’ll work hand in hand with Strategy, as well as Copy, Design, Social and Production, to understand the audience, cultural context, role of each channel and each stage of the funnel, and translate that thinking into strong creative.
This isn’t purely an art direction role. You need to be able to come up with strong campaign ideas, build on other people’s ideas and turn them into something bigger.

Key Responsibilities

Develop strong global campaign ideas and creative platforms that can live across markets, channels and executions.
Partner closely with strategists from the beginning of the process, challenging and building on briefs rather than simply receiving them.
Understand the role creative plays across the full funnel, from building awareness and brand desire to communicating product benefits, driving consideration and supporting conversion.
Know when an execution needs to build the brand, when it needs to explain the product and when it simply needs to make someone want it.
Turn strategy, product benefits and consumer insights into simple, relevant creative ideas.
Build global creative platforms that have a clear central idea while leaving enough room for markets to make them culturally relevant.
Lead the visual direction of brands across product, lifestyle, talent and culture-led work.
Find interesting ways to communicate ingredients, efficacy, innovation and science without everything suddenly looking clinical.
Make products feel desirable through photography, film, CGI, design, casting, styling and storytelling.
Bring product and lifestyle together naturally, rather than creating a beautiful lifestyle campaign and remembering the product at the end.
Develop ideas around talent, creators, partnerships and cultural moments that make sense for the brand and the market.
Think beyond traditional campaign formats and identify opportunities across social, experiences, collaborations, entertainment and emerging culture.
Lead work from concept through production, keeping the original idea and level of craft intact along the way.
Present and sell creative thinking to senior clients and stakeholders across different markets.
Lead and develop multidisciplinary and international creative teams.

What we’re looking for

A Creative Director who is conceptually strong and visually sophisticated, with a portfolio that shows range.
Big campaign thinking
Ideas with a clear point of view that can become genuine global platforms, not just a collection of executions.
Strong visual taste
A great eye for photography, film, casting, styling, design and contemporary brand aesthetics.
Product storytelling
Experience making products, ingredients, technology or benefits interesting and desirable, especially when there’s real science or efficacy behind them.
Full-funnel creative thinking
An understanding of how people move from discovering a brand to considering and buying it, and how the creative job changes along the way.
Strong creative + strategy partnership
Someone who likes working closely with strategists, has a point of view on the brief and knows how to turn strategic thinking into creative opportunities.
Global thinking
Experience developing work for multiple markets and understanding the difference between a global idea and simply making the same campaign appear everywhere. You should be comfortable collaborating with local teams and adapting ideas around different cultural behaviors and audiences without losing the core creative thought.
Lifestyle and culture
Work that shows an understanding of how brands can play in culture through talent, creators, collaborations, social, entertainment and experiences.
Range
We want someone who can create a beautiful product or efficacy story and then switch gears into a culturally relevant lifestyle campaign without either feeling forced.

Key Requirements

10+ years of creative experience, ideally across agencies and/or ambitious consumer brands.
Significant experience working on global brands and international campaigns.
Experience leading integrated and full-funnel campaigns, from brand-building through product and conversion-focused creative.
Background in wellness, beauty, personal care, lifestyle, premium CPG or adjacent categories.
Experience working closely with Strategy on audiences, consumer journeys, cultural insights and creative briefs.
Experience working with product claims, ingredients, efficacy or science-led briefs is a plus.
Strong photography and film production experience.
Experience working with talent, creators or culturally driven campaigns.
Experience leading multidisciplinary and international creative teams.
Excellent client-facing and presentation skills.
Native or near-native English, or equivalent professional fluency developed through extensive experience working in English. This person needs to be able to concept, debate, present and sell creative ideas confidently in English with senior global clients and teams.

Portfolio

We want to see ideas, taste and range.
Showcase strong campaigns, as well as activations, social ideas, collaborations and product experiences that demonstrate different ways brands can connect with people.
We want to see work that feels relevant to its audience, where the product matters and the visual execution is strong.

Languages

English (mandatory)
Spanish (preferably)
Any other languages are a plus.

What we offer

Remote flex Fridays from 9:00 AM to 2.30 PM.
Three weeks of remote work per year.
Summer working hours across July and August (9:00 AM to 4.00 PM).
Free English & Spanish classes to boost your global communication skills.
Access to Wellhub, a wellness platform offering a wide range of fitness and wellbeing options.
Flexible retribution plan for meals, transport and childcare.
Holidays: 22 working days + 3 days established by the collective agreement + national and local public holidays.
Bright, spacious offices in the heart of Barcelona.
Competitive salary with real growth opportunities.
A global environment, cutting-edge tools, and a culture driven by trends and innovation.

jobs.title: Creative Director
jobs.description:
Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

As the Creative Director at Audible, you will be a critical part of our creative team and overall business. As the creative lead in our UK hub, you will work closely with partners across the company to translate strategic briefs into bold, fresh, culturally resonant creative. You will develop and deliver work across every customer channel and touchpoint, from original content campaigns to product launches and major brand initiatives. You will balance a globally minded vision, aligning with counterparts and peers across markets, with local relevance and nuance. Your leadership will be seen in the mentoring of junior teams, partnership with agencies, and in your own direct creative contributions.

You will lead the creative concepting, development and production of 360-degree campaigns for Audible Originals, Exclusives and third-party titles, including title key art, live action shoots, trailers and print. You will manage projects across their life cycle, from pitch to post-production. You will inspire and motivate your team, shepherding creative at all stages while providing guidance and direction.

About You

You are a driven, passionate creative at heart—a leader with the vision to help shape a brand’s evolution and the craft to execute it with excellence. You live and breathe culture and know how to make a brand stand out while staying true to its core values. You have deep experience in entertainment marketing as well as brand-forward campaigns. You understand how to balance global brand consistency with local cultural nuance. You anticipate production needs and manage workflows to achieve results while ensuring work is delivered on-time and on-budget. You are a hands-on leader who inspires teams and partners to push boundaries, delivering work that is strategically smart, emotionally compelling, and visually exceptional.

As the Creative Director, you will…

Define the overarching creative strategy for one or more marketing programs, leading internal and external teams to concept, develop, and execute 360-degree campaigns in support of Audible Originals, Exclusives and third-party titles across owned and paid channels, all platforms, and all media
Directly contribute to the development of high-impact brand campaigns, product launches, activations, and initiatives that build awareness and affinity for Audible
Focus on campaigns originating in the UK, with potential to expand to the Australian market and emerging markets
Direct and guide writing and production of key campaign assets including talent-led celebrity scripts, trailers, social-first executions, live action shoots, and key art
Guide and select external agency partners, directing their creative output at the highest level of craft while managing celebrity talent and high-profile partners across campaign milestones
Lead campaign presentations and pitches with internal and external partners, talent, and leadership, clearly articulating creative vision, strategy, and business rationale
Drive creative alignment across cross-functional stakeholders, influencing priorities and tactical elements owned by adjacent teams to ensure cohesive brand storytelling
Manage a high volume of overlapping projects and complex requests, effectively prioritizing across and up the organization while making creative trade-off decisions that balance team, business, and customer needs
Develop and optimize creative workflows and production processes to improve efficiency, scalability, and consistency, building mechanisms that support long-term operational excellence
Integrate cultural insights, audience research, and performance data into creative strategies, synthesizing disparate inputs into compelling campaign ideas and creative territories
Lead by example — mentoring and developing junior creatives, inspiring teams and partners to push boundaries, experiment, and challenge the status quo

About Audible

jobs.title: Social Creative & Art Director
jobs.description:
En We Are Social Madrid estamos buscando a un/a Art Director
para sumarse a una de nuestras cuentas clave dentro de la agencia. No buscamos un perfil de Dirección de Arte tradicional que solo diseñe key visuals en Photoshop, sino alguien que viva y piense en social.

Buscamos a una persona con una sólida formación e instinto en Dirección de Arte,
pero que entienda que la creatividad hoy se construye en vertical y en tiempo real. Necesitamos una persona que combine pensamiento estratégico para entender la narrativa visual de una marca, y al mismo tiempo capacidad de ejecución hands-on para grabar, editar y dar un acabado visual impecable a las ideas.

Requirements

¿Cómo será tu día a día?

Crear conceptos frescos, originales y 100% nativos para TikTok, Instagram Reels y YouTube Shorts que generen conversación y conecten con la audiencia.
Perder la vergüenza, coger el móvil o la cámara, salir a la calle, definir el encuadre, la luz y la estética para captar recursos visuales, vox pops o encuestas con una dirección estética cuidada y profesional.
Más allá del vídeo, serás responsable de la bajada gráfica de las campañas. Desde la ideación de key visuals y el diseño de carruseles, hasta el cuidado minucioso de la tipografía, el color y el layout, asegurando que cada píxel respire la identidad de la marca.
Redactar o supervisar guiones, dirigir (o protagonizar) los vídeos y editar el contenido final en herramientas Premiere, suite de Adobe o como CapCut, aplicando el ritmo visual perfecto para cada plataforma.
Estar al día con los cambios de algoritmo, estéticas emergentes, formatos visuales y audios en tendencia para aplicar oportunidades orgánicas a la estrategia del cliente.
Trabajar codo con codo con los equipos de Cuentas, Research & Insights y Estrategia para garantizar que la dirección de arte y las ideas creativas respondan a los objetivos de negocio y eleven la imagen de marca.

¿Qué es lo que estamos buscando?

Formación o background consolidado en Dirección de Arte.
Capacidad para aportar un look & feel elevado a los contenidos sin perder la frescura y velocidad que exigen las redes sociales.
Al menos 3 años en un rol de Dirección de Arte o creación de contenido visual similar, preferiblemente en agencia creativa o marca.
Manejo fluido del ecosistema Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator, etc.). Se valorarán conocimientos de animación.
Capacidad para estructurar ideas, redactar guiones visuales y adaptar textos o copys para acompañar el contenido.
Instinto natural para detectar tendencias visuales en redes y aplicarlas de forma orgánica.
Nivel de inglés alto.
Capacidad para priorizar tareas y gestionar entregas en entornos dinámicos.
Deseable: Experiencia previa o fuerte afinidad con el sector del entretenimiento, cine, series o cultura pop.

Transparencia salarial

En We Are Social nos lo tomamos en serio. Para cumplir con la Directiva Europea de Transparencia Salarial, nos pondremos en contacto contigo antes de la entrevista para informarte en detalle sobre el rango salarial y el convenio colectivo aplicable a este puesto, ¡queremos que cuentes con toda la información desde el primer momento!

Benefits

🖥️ Formato de trabajo híbrido.

🏠 Ayuda mensual para costear los gastos asociados al teletrabajo.

🏝️Trabaja desde donde quieras en Semana Santa, julio, agosto y Navidades.

🌏 Posibilidad de teletrabajar hasta 10 días al año desde cualquier oficina de la red.

😎22 días de vacaciones, más 3 días adicionales en Semana Santa, 3 o 4 en Navidad y el día de tu cumpleaños.

🥗& 🚍 Ayuda mensual para costear tus gastos de comida, transporte, seguro médico y/o guardería.

💸 Retribución flexible

🤸🏽‍♂️Acceso a una amplia red de gimnasios y servicios de fisioterapia y terapia gracias a Wellhub (Gympass). Acceso a apps referencia en el mundo de la nutrición, sueño, meditación, etc.

📚Formación continua y personalizada.

💭 Clases de inglés

Diversidad e Inclusión

Creemos que la Diversidad e Inclusión a todos los niveles son cruciales para la innovación creativa, por lo que estamos construyendo activamente una cultura en la que todo el mundo tenga las mismas oportunidades de desarrollarse.

Una cultura en la que las personas tengan las herramientas que necesitan para ser su mejor versión y para enfocarse en crear trabajos que definan su carrera profesional. Para conseguirlo fomentamos un entorno libre, en el que se respetan la diversidad de ideas y la honestidad, y en el que las diferentes perspectivas nos ayuda a ser mejores.

Genau dafür suchen wir dich.

t entwickelst du nicht einfach Marketingkonzepte. Du schaffst Strategien, die Unternehmen dabei helfen, sichtbar zu wachsen, Marken zu schärfen und Menschen nachhaltig zu erreichen.

Du hilfst unseren Kund:innen dabei, bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Nicht durch Bauchgefühl. Sondern durch Strategie.

jobs.description:
Job Title

Media & Digital Marketing Manager

Job Description

Job title:

Media & Digital Marketing Manager

Your Role

The Media & Digital Marketing Manager is responsible for leading Philips Personal Health Türkiye's integrated media strategy and consumer engagement agenda across paid, owned, and earned channels. The role drives brand growth, consumer demand generation, media effectiveness, and commercial performance by orchestrating both offline and digital media investments throughout the consumer journey.

The role serves as the single point of accountability for media planning, consumer acquisition, digital engagement, retail media, content amplification, and marketing effectiveness, ensuring all media investments contribute to brand building and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Integrated Media Strategy

Develop and execute annual integrated media strategy across all Personal Health categories.
Build full-funnel communication plans covering Awareness, Consideration, Conversion, and Loyalty.
Ensure alignment between brand objectives, consumer insights, and media investments.
Lead media investment optimization across all touchpoints to maximize business impact.

Digital & Performance Marketing

Lead performance marketing across Search, Social, Programmatic, Video, Display, Retail Media, and Emerging Platforms.
Drive consumer acquisition, engagement, and conversion objectives.
Continuously optimize campaigns through data, testing, and audience insights.
Manage media agency performance and execution excellence.

Retail Media & E-Commerce Acceleration

Develop retail media strategies with key business partners.
Drive visibility and traffic generation across strategic retail partners.
Support D2C growth through integrated media investments.
Partner with Commercial and E-Commerce teams to maximize campaign effectiveness.

Content Amplification & Social Media

Define content distribution strategy across all media channels.
Collaborate with content teams and agencies to maximize content performance.
Lead influencer, creator, and advocacy activation programs.
Drive ratings & reviews and consumer engagement initiatives.

Consumer Insights & Analytics

Translate consumer and shopper insights into actionable media strategies.
Monitor campaign effectiveness through advanced analytics and reporting.
Establish KPIs and performance dashboards.
Drive marketing effectiveness and ROI improvement initiatives.

Agency & Partner Management

Lead strategic relationships with media agencies, digital partners, and technology vendors.
Drive accountability for campaign performance and investment effectiveness.
Ensure best-practice media planning and buying standards.

Innovation & Capability Building

Identify emerging media trends and consumer behaviors.
Explore AI-driven marketing opportunities and automation solutions.
Introduce new media channels, measurement capabilities, and marketing technologies.

You're the right fit if:

Preferably 8+ years of experience in Media Planning, Digital Marketing, Performance Marketing, or Integrated Marketing roles.
Strong experience managing both offline and digital media investments across the full consumer journey.
Demonstrated success in driving brand growth, consumer acquisition, and revenue impact through media strategies.
Experience working with e-commerce, retail media, and D2C (Direct-to-Consumer) business models.
Proven track record of managing and optimizing large-scale media budgets and agency relationships.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Sales, Commercial, E-commerce, and Analytics.
Exposure to FMCG, Consumer Electronics, Personal Care, Retail, or Consumer Health industries preferred.
Experience using data, consumer insights, and marketing analytics to improve ROI and campaign effectiveness.

How We Work Together

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

About Philips

Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business, discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose.

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care.

jobs.title: AI Artist
jobs.description:
Portfolio first: please include a link to your portfolio or showreel in your application. Applications without a link will not be considered. You must be based in the Netherlands.

Who are we?

Wolfstreet is an Amsterdam-based creative and production agency specialized in visual content. We build campaigns and content for brands and agencies by combining what we do in-house: creative development, production and post-production. We work for brands like Vinted, Picnic, BUX, Stëlz and Mastercard.

Who are we looking for?

We’re looking for a Generative AI Artist with real taste and the technical skills to back it up, to join our in-house AI studio.
You sit somewhere between art director and technician. You know how to get exactly the image you have in mind out of a model, and you know when something isn’t good enough yet. You work closely with our post team on shots that need to hold up in a campaign, and just as closely with our creatives while ideas are still taking shape - from look development and moodfilms to final, production-ready output.
You combine a strong eye with a solid VFX foundation, so your work doesn’t stop at a nice generation: you make it fit, match and hold up in the final edit.

Taste first, tools second

Anyone can generate an image. What we’re after is someone who knows what makes an image right: composition, light, texture and consistency across a whole campaign. The tools change every month, taste and judgement don’t.
That’s why your portfolio is leading for us. Show us the work you’re proud of, and tell us how you made it.

What you’ll do

Develop looks, styleframes and visual concepts together with our creatives
Create production-ready AI imagery and video for campaigns, social and branded content
Build and maintain node-based workflows (e.g. ComfyUI) for consistent, controllable results
Work hand in hand with our online artists and editors to integrate AI shots into the final film
Handle the 2D side yourself where needed: compositing, clean-up, keying and matching
Keep track of new models and tools, test what’s worth it and help shape how we use AI at Wolfstreet

You

Have a portfolio that shows both strong taste and technical control - your portfolio is leading in our selection
Are an exceptional prompter who gets consistent, art-directed results instead of lucky shots
Know the current generative image and video tools inside out, and can build your own node setups
Have solid VFX basics: 2D compositing, clean-up, keying and a good understanding of how shots come together in post
Think like an art director, with a clear point of view on look, style and quality
Enjoy working with both post-production and creative teams, and communicate clearly
Speak fluent English (Dutch is not required) and live in the Netherlands

What we offer

€3,750 - €4,250 gross per month (excl. 8% holiday allowance), depending on experience
A 32 to 40 hour week, whichever suits you best
Ownership over your role and real creative freedom
Campaigns for big (inter)national brands
Pension scheme
An annual development budget, and time to actually use it
A real say in how AI and creative workflows evolve at Wolfstreet
Cool vibrant office space in Amsterdam Noord
Weekly drinks, regular events and a team that actually likes each other

How to apply

Send a short motivation, your CV and - most importantly - a link to your portfolio or showreel. Apply here or mail jobs@wolfstreet.nl.

jobs.title: Creative Strategist & Storyteller - YouTube + Instagram
jobs.description:
Creative Strategist & Storyteller

En Natulim mejoramos los productos clásicos de limpieza. Creamos productos sin residuos, prácticos de utilizar y con ingredientes buenos para la piel y el planeta.

Nuestro producto estrella es un detergente para la ropa en formato de tiras biodegradables
que se disuelven en la lavadora.

Sobre el rol

Buscamos un/a Creative Strategist & Storyteller
para desarrollar conceptos creativos que conviertan y elevar el nivel de nuestros contenido en vídeo: Meta, Ads y YouTube.

Buscamos una persona que combine criterio creativo, storytelling y mentalidad de performance
, capaz de detectar qué hace que un contenido funcione, transformar insights en conceptos potentes y convertirlos en piezas de vídeo que generen resultados.

El objetivo no es simplemente crear vídeos bonitos: es crear anuncios que capten la atención, mantengan la retención y conviertan
.

Trabajarás principalmente con formatos de Meta, YouTube y otras plataformas de paid social
, desarrollando conceptos tanto para vídeo short form como long form.

No es un rol de UGC ni de influencer marketing.

Es un rol de Creative Strategy → Concept → Hook → Narrative → Execution → Testing → Learning.

Responsabilidades

Definir la estrategia creativa de nuestros anuncios de vídeo
.

Desarrollar conceptos, ángulos y campañas orientadas a performance.

Crear hooks
capaces de captar la atención en los primeros segundos.

Escribir guiones y estructuras para anuncios short y long form
.

Diseñar diferentes narrativas, mensajes y formatos para testar.

Transformar insights de consumidor, producto y performance en nuevas ideas creativas.

Analizar anuncios propios y de la competencia para detectar
qué funciona, por qué funciona y cómo podemos mejorarlo
.

Analizar métricas creativas como CTR, hook rate, retention, CVR, CPA/ROAS
y utilizar estos aprendizajes para iterar.

Crear sistemas de testing de diferentes hooks, claims, estructuras, mensajes y CTAs.

Detectar tendencias y formatos relevantes y adaptarlos a la marca sin perder el foco en conversión.

Trabajar junto al equipo de edición para llevar los conceptos a ejecución.

Iterar rápidamente a partir de resultados y feedback.

Construir una biblioteca de conceptos y aprendizajes creativos
que permita escalar la producción de contenido.

Perfil que buscamos

+2 años de experiencia
en contenido creativo en vídeo, habiendo participado también en su edición y publicación.

Experiencia demostrable creando contenido que haya conseguido buenos resultados en redes o paid media
.

Experiencia trabajando con marcas de e-commerce, DTC y/o cosmética/beauty
.

Experiencia creando contenido para Meta Ads, YouTube Ads, TikTok Ads o plataformas similares
.

Haber participado en vídeos de YouTube con +50K visualizaciones
será muy valorado.

Experiencia tanto en short form como long form
.

Capacidad para escribir hooks, guiones y conceptos creativos
.

Mentalidad muy orientada a performance y conversión
.

Capacidad para entender métricas y utilizarlas para tomar decisiones creativas.

Criterio visual y capacidad para reconocer cuándo una pieza tiene potencial y cuándo no.

Perfil muy creativo, curioso y ejecutor
: alguien que propone ideas y sabe convertirlas en piezas reales.

Capacidad para entender por qué un anuncio funciona
y trasladar ese aprendizaje a nuevos conceptos.

Estar muy conectado/a con el ecosistema de contenido, publicidad digital y tendencias creativas.

Se valorará especialmente haber trabajado en equipos donde existiera un proceso continuo de testing → análisis → iteración → escala
.

Qué ofrecemos

Acceso y formación en herramientas de IA
, trabajando con tecnología puntera como Claude.

Contrato indefinido
, estabilidad laboral y oportunidades reales de crecimiento.

Jornada completa de lunes a viernes
, con flexibilidad de entrada y salida.

Formación interna y externa
para impulsar tu aprendizaje continuo.

Retribución flexible
adaptada a tus necesidades: seguro médico, restaurante, transporte y guardería.

Hasta un 50% de descuento en productos Natulim.

Días de adaptación escolar
, para acompañar a hijos menores de 3 años cuando lo necesites.

Un equipo joven, dinámico y con muy buen ambiente
, donde las personas y las ideas cuentan.

¡Únete a Natulim!

Si te apasiona crear contenido que capta la atención, cuentan historias y venden
, queremos conocerte.

jobs.description:
INDG is expanding the way high-volume visual content is produced: from CGI and 3D pipelines into AI-assisted image generation, editing, and content orchestration. This role exists to help turn generative AI from an experimental layer into a reliable production capability.

As a Generative-AI Artist (freelance), you will build and run image generation workflows that support real client production: fashion, sportswear, product imagery, talent visuals, campaign adaptations, and asset variation at scale. You will work inside the tension that defines this role: fast-moving AI models, production deadlines, visual realism, brand consistency, and systems that other people can actually use.

INDG has spent 20+ years building visual production systems for global brands. Grip extends that heritage into AI-orchestrated content production. Your work will help teams generate, edit, refine, and scale imagery while keeping outputs sharp enough for enterprise brand use.

What You Will Do

Build and Maintain Generative Image Workflows

Set up, configure, and troubleshoot custom ComfyUI workflows for image generation, image editing, inpainting, outpainting, upscaling, relighting, variation generation, and controlled composition.

You will connect models, nodes, prompts, masks, ControlNet inputs, LoRAs, reference images, and post-processing steps into repeatable workflows. The goal is not a one-off good image. The goal is a workflow that can produce consistent, usable outputs across many assets.

Apply AI to Production Content Problems

Use generative AI techniques against real production needs: adjusting apparel/footwear/accessories/equipment imagery, refining fashion/sportswear product shots, extending scenes, improving model consistency, generating controlled variations, or supporting creative teams with rapid image exploration.

You should understand that production images are judged on details: skin texture, garment fit, fabric behavior, seams, logos, lighting direction, pose plausibility, background continuity, and whether the image still feels brand-correct after generation.

Adapt Quickly as Models and Tools Change

Work confidently across diffusion-based models, LoRAs, ControlNet, IP-Adapter-style workflows, segmentation tools, inpainting models, outpainting methods, face and identity consistency techniques, and emerging image-generation systems.

You will test new models, identify where they improve or break the pipeline, and help the team decide when a tool is production-ready. You do not need every new release to be perfect. You need to know how to evaluate it, isolate failure modes, and translate it into a usable workflow.

Support a Pipeline Used by Artists and Production Teams

Document workflows clearly enough for artists, producers, and technical teams to reuse them. Package settings, prompts, node graphs, model dependencies, and output criteria in a way that reduces guesswork.

You will work with CGI artists, creative technologists, production leads, and platform teams to connect creative intent with operational execution. When something fails, you trace the system: model choice, conditioning input, prompt structure, mask quality, render reference, node configuration, or post-process step.

Requirements

Who You Are

You live at the intersection of image-making and systems-building. You care about the final image, but you also care about the workflow that created it.

You Have

Hands-on experience building and maintaining ComfyUI workflows, or comparable node-based generative AI systems.

A strong working knowledge of current image-generation methods: diffusion models, LoRAs, ControlNet, inpainting, outpainting, image-to-image workflows, upscaling, masking, reference-based ge

jobs.title: Senior Strategist (Brand & Creative)
jobs.description:
Boldspace are looking for someone with a strong track record in brand and integrated creative strategy, able to guide creative thinking, shape strategic direction for clients, and lead integrated strategic processes from insight through to execution. You should be comfortable acting as a trusted voice to clients and internal teams alike, helping define challenges, uncover opportunities, and develop work that delivers meaningful commercial and brand impact. A background spanning both brand and creative strategy is preferred, though not essential.

ABOUT BOLDSPACE

Boldspace is a brand value & creative agency. We help organisations grow their meaning, reputation and value through brand building, communications and analytics.

At our core is a combination of strategic thinking and creative advisory, helping clients move into new territory through brand campaigns that spark conversations and build reputation with the audiences that matter most. We are passionate about helping brands find their bold space: the unique territory where they are relevant, their audience cares, and they have the right to lead.

Since launch in 2020, our blend of strategy, creativity and technology has delivered positive impact for a diverse set of clients, including the Post Office, VISA, TGI Fridays, Deel, Virgin, Direct Line, Lovehoney, Boylesports and many more.

We are also the creators of Boldstream, our proprietary agentic AI SaaS platform designed for modern marketing and communications teams. Boldstream combines multi-LLM technology, integrated data and more than 100 specialist AI agents to support strategy, creativity, content and communications workflows in one connected system. The platform is used by live customers as well as internally by our own teams to help deliver smarter, faster and more effective work.

REQUIREMENTS

Lead strategic direction

Understand client businesses, audiences and objectives to help define clear strategic opportunities and solutions
Lead strategic thinking across accounts, helping shape both long-term brand direction and campaign development
Take ownership of strategic processes from briefing through to delivery and evaluation
Act as a trusted advisor to clients, building confidence through clear thinking, strong communication and commercial understanding
Identify opportunities for client and account growth, and contribute proactively to wider business development conversations
Set clear KPIs and success measures for strategic and creative work

Develop insight-driven thinking

Use a combination of quantitative and qualitative inputs to uncover meaningful insights and inform strategic recommendations
Be fluent in interpreting audience, cultural and market signals to shape compelling strategic responses
Lead stakeholder conversations and workshops that help uncover opportunities, align teams and inspire creative development
Stay informed on cultural, category and behavioural trends, translating these into relevant and actionable thinking for clients
Use tools including Boldstream and additional data sources to support strategic development and campaign effectiveness

Shape strategy and creative outputs

Contribute to the continued evolution of Boldspace’s approach to brand and communications strategy
Build clear strategic frameworks, positioning territories and communications platforms
Work closely with creative teams to develop ideas rooted in audience understanding and brand ambition
Craft compelling narratives, strategic presentations and client-facing materials
Identify key opportunities and friction points across brand and customer journeys
Support thought leadership initiatives including white papers, effectiveness case studies and agency marketing materials where relevant

YOU

Around 6+ years’ experience in an agency-side strategy, planning or brand role
Strong strategic thinking skills with the ability to balance commercial, creative and audience perspectives
Confident working across both brand and campaign strategy
Quantitatively and qualitatively fluent, with the ability to interpret data and insight without relying heavily on formal research processes
Comfortable leading conversations with senior clients and presenting strategic recommendations clearly and confidently
Organised and adaptable, able to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously
Strong written communication skills and experience creating polished client presentations
Curious about culture, behaviour and communications, with a natural instinct for spotting opportunities
Excited by the opportunity to work across both ambitious challenger brands and larger global accounts

BENEFITS

Pensions: a 5% employer contribution.
Holiday: unlimited holiday (including all UK public holidays) - we trust our staff to take the time they need and still excel in their jobs - and days off for birthdays and moving house are guaranteed!
Flexible working: 2/3 days per week in Soho office
Regular salary reviews: in line with a salary framework, to ensure equal pay for equal work and that we recognise and reward when your responsibilities increase.
Socials: team socials regularly, chosen by the team.
Team retreats: time to get to know each other away from the office.
Bonus: transparent bonus structure where you can receive a % of base salary based on personal and company performance.
Supporting good causes: we contribute some of our outperformance to charitable causes which the team help choose.
Wellness: time within working hours every week for those that want or need it.
Monthly benefits budget: £50 per month, every month, to spend on whatever you want - from a home delivered vegetable box and discounted gym memberships, to mental health support and professional coaching

A CARBON NEUTRAL BUSINESS

Boldspace (B Corp) measures its performance on profit, people and planet combined. From day one, we will offset your carbon footprint entirely. The cost of this is covered 100% by the company.

jobs.description:
Paid Media Creative Strategist – Nest Commerce

London (Hybrid)

About Nest

Nest Commerce is one of the UK’s fastest-growing performance marketing agencies, built for ecommerce and retail brands. We partner with category-leading names such as Urban Outfitters, Reiss, Damson Madder, Crew Clothing and Hims, helping them scale sustainably through cutting-edge performance strategy and proprietary technology. Our in-house AI platform, Hummingbird, gives us an unmatched competitive edge by automating optimisation, generating creative at scale, and empowering our teams to deliver market-leading results. We’re founder-led, independent, and fiercely ambitious, with a culture that blends commercial impact with genuine care for our people.

We’re now looking for an ambitious Paid Media Creative Strategist to join Nest Studio, our in-house creative function. In this role, you will play a central part in shaping best-in-class paid media creative for some of the UK’s most exciting digital brands.

Key Responsibilities

You will design and lead strategic workshops with senior client stakeholders, uncovering insight and setting the creative direction.
You will partner with clients to implement best-in-class creative processes across paid social and broader digital channels, and you will develop high-performing, platform-native ad concepts for Meta, TikTok, Google and Snap.
The role involves writing clear, compelling briefs for content creators and internal teams, as well as building scalable testing frameworks that continually refine creative output.
You will analyse performance data, heatmaps and platform insights to optimise creative strategies, working closely with media managers to translate data into effective creative solutions.
You will also act as the main creative contact for client communication, relationship management and presentations.

Candidate Experience

We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced performance environment and brings experience in paid media creative
You should be a digital-native thinker with a portfolio that showcases Meta and TikTok-led work, and someone who understands paid-media best practice, trends, formats and platform nuances
You’ll need to be comfortable using on- and off-platform metrics as signals to guide creative decisions, and confident in communicating, presenting and collaborating with a positive, solutions-focused mindset
You should have a track record of developing performance-driven creative ideas that are native to Meta, TikTok and paid social channels, as well as experience turning data, analytics and testing insights into clear and actionable creative direction
The role also involves running workshops, facilitating discussions, influencing senior stakeholders and managing multiple briefs across different clients while maintaining clarity, pace and organisation
You should be able to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, from persona development and audits through to briefing, testing and optimisation

Company Benefits

Nest offers one of the strongest benefits packages in the performance marketing industry

We operate hybrid working with three days a week in our Kentish Town office, which is dog-friendly
The team enjoys weekly socials and Thursday learning sessions
After four years you will receive a six-week paid sabbatical, with the option to add a further six unpaid weeks

Team members can work abroad for up to ten consecutive days per year
Holiday entitlement includes 25 days plus 8 bank holidays
We provide enhanced parental leave and fertility support, access to Techscheme and Cyclescheme, and one annual volunteering day alongside a £1,000 monthly charity donation
Our culture is driven by transparent, founder-led leadership and built on ownership, innovation, resilience and rapid problem-solving.

Due to a high volume of applications, we may not be able to respond to everyone individually. All candidates for this role are being managed exclusively by our recruitment partner, who will be in touch with those selected for the next stage of the process.

jobs.title: AI Creative Specialist | jij maakt beeld en video met de blik van een fotograaf | 2 vacatures
jobs.description:
Vacatureomschrijving

Je ziet wanneer het licht niet klopt. Wanneer een stof te glad oogt, een schoen zijn vorm verliest of een camerabeweging onnatuurlijk voelt. En je kunt uitleggen wat er moet veranderen om het beeld wél te laten werken.

Als AI Creative Specialist bij Omoda Brands gebruik je die vakkennis om foto- en videocontent met AI te produceren. Je helpt onze AI-productie opzetten: van productreferentie en briefing tot een consistente serie beelden die past bij het product, het kanaal en het merk.

Wat een AI Specialist Creatie bij ons is

Je combineert kennis van fotografie en visuele productie met praktisch gebruik van generatieve AI. Je begrijpt hoe een goed beeld wordt opgebouwd en kunt die keuzes vertalen naar referenties, instructies, instellingen en nabewerking.

Je maakt zelf content met AI en beoordeelt het resultaat. Belichting, perspectief, compositie, styling en materiaalweergave zijn voor jou concrete middelen om een beeld te sturen.

We maken al productbeelden met AI. Jij helpt ons om reproduceerbare productiewerkwijzes te maken voor Assem, Omoda, Wehkamp en Kleertjes.com. Daarbij bewaak je het eigen karakter van ieder merk, binnen de bestaande creatieve richting.

Wat je doet

Je produceert met AI beeld- en videocontent voor onder meer productpresentaties, outfits, interieurs en campagnes.
Je vertaalt briefings en merkrichtlijnen naar concrete keuzes in licht, compositie, achtergrond, styling, kadrering en beweging.
Je selecteert geschikte productbeelden en visuele referenties en bepaalt welke input nodig is om een betrouwbaar resultaat te krijgen.
Je werkt met bestaande AI-tools, stuurt de generatie gericht bij en combineert die waar nodig met fotografie, retouche en montage.
Je controleert of het product herkenbaar en correct blijft: kleur, vorm, verhoudingen, materiaal, prints, logo’s en details moeten overeenkomen met de referentie.
Je beoordeelt beelden op fotografische kwaliteit en merkstijl en corrigeert afwijkingen voordat ze worden aangeboden voor publicatie.
Je let bij video op natuurlijke beweging, montage en continuïteit: een product, persoon of kledingstuk moet gedurende de opname consistent blijven.
Je ontwikkelt herbruikbare werkwijzen, referentiesets en instellingen waarmee je ook een volgende serie op hetzelfde kwaliteitsniveau kunt maken.
Je legt vast hoe content tot stand komt en helpt collega’s met de werkwijze en kwaliteitscontrole.
Je test nieuwe mogelijkheden binnen concrete producties en beoordeelt of ze bruikbare kwaliteit en tijdwinst opleveren.

Een aantrekkelijk beeld moet ook het juiste product laten zien. Je herkent wanneer extra nabewerking, een andere aanpak of aanvullende fotografie nodig is.

Functie-eisen

Assem, Omoda, Wehkamp en Kleertjes.com hebben ieder een eigen uitstraling en doelgroep. Jij kunt die verschillen herkennen en vertalen naar de content die je maakt.

Je werkt vanuit de creatieve kaders van het betreffende merk en stemt af met de betrokken creatieve collega’s. Je bewaakt dat een serie samenhangend blijft, ook wanneer er meerdere producten, formaten of varianten worden gemaakt.

Je kijkt daarbij zowel naar het afzonderlijke beeld als naar het geheel: klopt de stijl op een productpagina, binnen een campagne en naast de andere content van het merk?

Wat je meebrengt

Je hebt een stevige basis in professionele fotografie of visuele productie, bijvoorbeeld als fotograaf, retoucher, beeldmaker of artdirector met praktische productie-ervaring.
Je begrijpt belichting, compositie, perspectief, kleur en materiaalweergave en kunt benoemen waarom een beeld wel of niet werkt.
Je hebt ervaring met product-, fashion- of lifestylebeelden en kunt werken binnen verschillende merkstijlen.
Je hebt zelf beelden gemaakt met generatieve AI en kunt laten zien hoe je het resultaat hebt gestuurd en verbeterd.
Je beheerst beeldbewerking en retouche, bijvoorbeeld in Photoshop of vergelijkbare software.
Je hebt gevoel voor bewegend beeld en kunt onnatuurlijke bewegingen, montageproblemen en inconsistenties herkennen. Praktische ervaring met videoproductie of montage is een plus.
Je werkt nauwkeurig en kunt een goed resultaat vertalen naar een werkwijze die opnieuw bruikbaar is.
Voor deze functie is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal vereist.

Je hoeft niet ieder AI-model of iedere tool te kennen. We zoeken iemand die weet wat goede fotografie en video zijn en die met AI kan leren realiseren. Je portfolio en inhoudelijke oordeel wegen zwaar. Programmeren is geen vereiste.

Aanvullende informatie

Je team

Je maakt deel uit van het AI-team en werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit creatie, fotografie, studio, content en de verschillende merken. Jij brengt het fotografische en creatieve vakmanschap en ontwikkelt de praktische werkwijze in de beschikbare tools. Voor maatwerksoftware, complexe automatisering of technische integraties werk je samen met AI Product Builders en AI Engineers.

Over Omoda Brands

Omoda Brands is het huis achter Assem, Omoda, Wehkamp en Kleertjes.com. Vier merken, ruim 2.000 collega’s en meer dan 3 miljoen klanten per jaar. Onze ambitie is de meest persoonlijke boutique op schaal. Beeld helpt klanten daarbij: het laat zien hoe een product eruitziet, hoe je het combineert en hoe het past in je leven. We maken al productbeelden met AI en willen die productie verder ontwikkelen. Jij helpt ons foto- en videocontent maken die aantrekkelijk, productgetrouw en herkenbaar is voor ieder merk.

Wat je bij ons vindt

Flexibel werken vanuit Zierikzee, Amsterdam of Zwolle. We komen gemiddeld 1 à 2 dagen per week samen op één van deze locaties.
32–38 uur per week, afhankelijk van jouw voorkeur.
Een passend salaris op basis van jouw kennis, ervaring en de waarde die je meebrengt.
De kans om AI-productie voor vier bekende merken op te gaan zetten.
Concrete producten, creatieve briefings en beeldmateriaal om mee te werken.
Ruimte om je fotografische vakkennis toe te passen op nieuwe productiemethoden.
Samenwerking met creatieve collega’s en technische specialisten.
Zichtbaar werk dat klanten helpt producten te ontdekken en te kiezen.

Interesse?

Laat ons zien wat je hebt gemaakt en vooral hoe je daartoe kwam. Deel enkele relevante beelden of video’s, waaronder een voorbeeld waarin je AI hebt gebruikt. Wat was de briefing, wat was jouw eigen bijdrage en hoe stuurde je op fotografische kwaliteit, productgetrouwheid en merkstijl?

We zien graag hoe je van referentie of eerste versie naar het uiteindelijke resultaat kwam. Een compact portfolio, link of voor-en-na-voorbeeld is voldoende; in het gesprek gaan we er samen dieper op in. Je hoeft geen nieuwe opdracht voor je sollicitatie te maken of vertrouwelijk materiaal te delen.

jobs.title: Digital & AI Leader
jobs.description:
CareGlance cerca una persona per il ruolo chiave di responsabile della componente digitale, software e di intelligenza artificiale del prodotto CareGlance: dall'interfaccia operatore agli algoritmi di Machine Learning per l'elaborazione real-time dei dati/immagini, con l’uso dell'AI per il completamento del prodotto industriale hardware/software.

Chi siamo

CareGlance è una PMI innovativa italiana con un portafoglio di brevetti proprietari. Sviluppiamo sensori ottici basati su tecnologia Swept Source-Optical Coherence Tomography (SS-OCT) per il controllo qualità ad alta precisione dei processi di manifattura industriale.
La sede principale è a Milano, mentre a Bari stiamo sviluppando un polo dedicato alle competenze software e digitali, in collaborazione con università e istituti di ricerca.
Siamo supportati da investitori istituzionali e collaboriamo con partner industriali e centri di ricerca in Europa.

Il ruolo

Cerchiamo un/una Digital & AI leader che assuma la responsabilità della formazione / gestione della nuova area Digital, Software e AI di CareGlance. La persona si inserirà in un contesto multidisciplinare (fotonica, elettronica, meccanica, che necessitano di software per controllo e acquisizione dati/ricostruzione di immagini) e avrà il compito di trasformare i dati generati dai nostri sistemi in un prodotto digitale affidabile, semplice e industrializzabile, comprensivo di un’interfaccia utente evoluta.
Il ruolo prevede specifiche aree di azione:
1. Prodotto software e interfaccia utente
Portare a livello di prodotto industriale la parte software dei sistemi CareGlance: acquisizione dati, visualizzazione real-time, restituzione dei risultati. L'obiettivo è un'interfaccia operatore chiara, robusta, utilizzabile da personale non specializzato.
2. Algoritmi AI e Machine Learning
Guidare lo sviluppo e l'industrializzazione degli algoritmi di AI/ML che elaborano i dati provenienti dai sensori. La persona lavorerà con le risorse già presenti per svolgere tutte le attività di trasformazione dell’algoritmo di ricostruzione delle immagini (brevettato da CareGlance), validare i risultati e portare l'architettura verso tecnologie adatte ad un real-time industriale.
3. Costruzione e guida del team
Il/la Digital & AI Leader supervisionerà direttamente le risorse già operanti in azienda sullo sviluppo software e guiderà la selezione, l'inserimento e la crescita delle persone che entreranno nel polo di Bari.

Responsabilità principali

Selezionare, formare e far crescere le persone del team Digital & AI.
Definire l'architettura software e AI del prodotto CareGlance, in coordinamento con il System Lead e tutta l’area R&D
Coordinare lo sviluppo del software per il primo prodotto: controllo dispositivi, acquisizione dati, elaborazione real-time, visualizzazione risultati.
Progettare e implementare loop di auto-training su lavorazioni industriali.
Lavorare a stretto contatto con le competenze di fotonica, elettronica e meccanica di sistema.

Requisiti obbligatori

Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Ingegneria dell'Automazione o discipline affini.
Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di prodotti software o soluzioni AI/ML in contesti industriali o di prodotto (con attenzione all’esperienza utente)
Competenze solide di programmazione in Python e nell'ecosistema AI/ML
Esperienza nello sviluppo e nella validazione di algoritmi di Machine Learning.
Capacità ' di comprendere gli algoritmi esistenti (incluso codice Matlab)
Buona conoscenza dell'inglese scritto e parlato.
Autonomia, concretezza, capacità di lavorare in un contesto imprenditoriale in evoluzione rapida.

Requisiti preferenziali

Esperienza con dati provenienti da sensori e dispositivi fisici, elaborazioni real-time o sistemi embedded.
Conoscenza di architetture GPU per l'accelerazione di algoritmi numerici.
Esperienza in startup o PMI innovative, in contesti multidisciplinari hardware + software.
Familiarità con tecniche di computer vision o signal processing applicate a contesti industriali.
Esperienza nella progettazione di pipeline di training continuo (MLOps, auto-labeling, feedback loop).

Sede e organizzazione

Sede principale: Milano, dove la persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con la direzione, il System Lead e il team R&D.
Il ruolo prevede la supervisione operativa del polo di Bari dedicato allo sviluppo software e digitale, con trasferte periodiche.
Modalità di lavoro ibrida (al termine del periodo di prova) e orario flessibile.

Cosa offriamo

Contratto a tempo indeterminato (CCNL Metalmeccanico)
RAL tra i 45.000 e i 50.000 euro. Disponibili a valutare profili anche maggiormente qualificati.
Un ruolo di leadership nella costruzione dell'area Digital & AI
Collaborazione diretta con la direzione e con il team R&D su un prodotto deep-tech innovativo.
Collaborazione con partner industriali e centri di ricerca in Europa.
Ambiente di lavoro snello, flessibile, con impatto reale sulle scelte tecnologiche e di prodotto.

jobs.description:
Our In-Scene Advertising
platform, AdCubes
, is growing rapidly. As the number of active campaigns on our platform increases, we are looking for an experienced Creative Strategist
to join our team.

AdCubes is built on a virtual product placement AI model we developed. It allows us to seamlessly insert 3D placements into any 2D video. For each campaign, we prepare “cubes” (our 3D creatives), which can be placed into the desired scene with a single click-making them look as if they were truly part of the scene. Check out adcubes.com for examples.

Hundreds of creators registered on our platform upload their videos each week before publishing. The platform automatically matches them with best-fit campaigns and makes the cube placements. Once creators share the videos with cube placements, they earn income per view, while brands are also billed on a cost-per-view basis. 
At a time when our brand and campaign volume is rapidly growing, and we are onboarding many of the region’s largest advertisers, we continue to evolve our platform on every level. We are looking for a Creative Strategist
who will not only manage campaigns with us but also bring a multidisciplinary approach to developing creative concepts, building inspiring presentations, and working alongside our 3D team to deliver standout projects.

Understand client briefs creatively and turn ideas into 3D ad creative concepts.

and craft compelling, visually engaging presentations.
Collaborate closely with the 3D team to guide creative outputs.
Deliver projects that inspire brands and elevate the in-scene advertising experience.

, bridging design, copywriting and brand strategy.

2+ years of experience within creative teams.

Strong storytelling and presentation skills.

Thrive in a high functioning team with in depth industry knowledge in media, creator economy, and generative AI.

jobs.title: Creative Strategist Italien 100% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du siehst eine Ad und weißt sofort, warum sie funktioniert – oder warum nicht. Hooks, die den Scroll stoppen. Angles, die konvertieren. Creatives, die aus Aufmerksamkeit Umsatz machen. Bei SHEKO bekommst Du die Bühne dafür: Du bist der kreative Kopf hinter unserem Launch in Italien.

Über SHEKO

Als Online-Shop gestartet, sind wir heute eine der am schnellsten wachsenden Health & Nutrition Brands Deutschlands – mit Balance Shakes, Kollagen, Probiotika und Supplements, die in dm, Rossmann und Müller stehen. Inhabergeführt, profitabel, mit echtem Wachstum vor uns. Nächster Halt: Italien. Und Du übernimmst dabei die kreative Führung.

Aufgaben

Creative Testing mit hoher Schlagzahl

Du konzipierst und briefst 10–20 Creative-Experimente (Batches) pro Woche für Meta, Google und YouTube – und sorgst so für einen konstanten Strom frischer, performanter Assets. Von Research und Angle-Ideation bis zum fertigen Creative-Briefing mit Hooks, visuellen Cues und Copy.

Full-Funnel Ownership

Du verantwortest den gesamten Creative-Lifecycle: Marktrecherche, Hypothese, Briefing, Übergabe an die Produktion, Performance-Post-Mortem. Du weißt genau, warum eine Ad gewonnen hat – oder warum sie gefloppt ist – und machst daraus den nächsten Batch.

Italien-Expertise

Du übersetzt keine Wörter, Du übersetzt Intention. Du verstehst, wie sich der italienische Konsument vom deutschen unterscheidet – in Ästhetik, Tonalität, Lifestyle und Essgewohnheiten – und machst aus diesen Nuancen Creatives, die kulturell wirklich resonieren.

Benchmarking & Marktanalyse

Du vergleichst die italienische Creative-Performance laufend mit unserem bewährten deutschen Playbook: Was lässt sich adaptieren, was muss neu gedacht werden? Du trackst Deine Winning-Angle-Rate und lieferst wöchentlich eine Einschätzung, wie sich der italienische Markt im Vergleich zum deutschen Setup verhält.

Performance & Zusammenarbeit

Dein North Star: Neukundenumsatz bei Ziel-ROAS. Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unseren Paid Social Buyern, unserem Paid Search Manager und unseren Video Editors und Freelance Creators – und schlägst frühzeitig Alarm, wenn Creative Fatigue einsetzt, inklusive mutiger Vorschläge, um die Performance oben zu halten.

Qualifikation

Must-have

Italienisch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und ein tiefes Gespür für italienische Kultur, Medien und Konsumenten

Erfahrung als Creative Strategist, Performance Creative oder in einer ähnlichen Rolle im D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld

Du denkst datengetrieben – in ROAS, CTR, Hook Rates und Winning-Angle-Rates, nicht in Bauchgefühl

Starke Briefing-Skills: Du schreibst Hooks, Skripte und Creative-Tickets, mit denen Editoren und Designer direkt loslegen können

Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenständig und mit hohem Output – Du weißt, was zu tun ist, ohne dass es jemand ansagen muss

Fließendes Englisch + solides Deutsch für die tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Hamburger Team

Nice-to-have

Erfahrung mit Health-, Nutrition- oder Wellness-Brands

Vertrautheit mit dem deutschen D2C-Markt oder mit der Skalierung von Brands über mehrere Märkte

Hands-on-Skills in Canva, CapCut, Figma oder AI-Creative-Tools

Grundverständnis von Media Buying auf Meta und Google

Benefits

Echte Gestaltungsfreiheit:
Flache Hierarchien, offene Feedback-Kultur und die Möglichkeit, ein wachsendes Unternehmen aktiv mitzuprägen

Persönliche Entwicklung:
Wir entwickeln gemeinsam Karriereziele, die zu Dir passen – fachlich wie persönlich

Starkes Team:
Hands-On-Mentalität, enormer Zusammenhalt und eine Kultur, in der gegenseitige Unterstützung selbstverständlich ist

Modernes Office:
Wohlfühlfaktor in Hamburg-Winterhude, zentral am schönen Mühlenkamp in Alsternähe. Dresscode? Komm wie Du Dich am wohlsten fühlst

Die Basics:
Wasser, Tee, Kaffee & Shake-Flat, regelmäßige Team-Events und legendäre Firmenpartys

Das klingt nach Dir? Dann bewirb Dich mit Deinem Lebenslauf. Ein Anschreiben ist kein Muss – aber wenn Du uns kurz erzählst, welche Ad Du zuletzt gebaut hast und worauf Du stolz warst, lesen wir das sehr gerne. Wir freuen uns auf Dich.

jobs.title: TØTE | Creative Strategist (DTC Performance Advertising)
jobs.description:
Stuur je CV, korte motivatie & portfolio naar careers@totelabel.com
Creative Strategist (DTC Performance Advertising)

Bepaal de creatieve strategie achter een van de snelstgroeiende e-commerce merken van Amsterdam. Vertaal klantinzichten, trends en performance data naar creatieve concepten die kunnen schalen, van de eerste hook tot de uiteindelijke ad. Je werkt direct samen met de founders en het creative team aan de ideeën en campagnes die bepalen waar TØTE naartoe gaat.

Belangrijk

Dit is geen algemene creatieve of socialmediafunctie.

Voor deze rol zoeken we specifiek iemand die:
Directe, hands-on ervaring heeft als Creative Strategist of in een vergelijkbare rol binnen DTC / e-commerce bij een agency of vergelijkbare brand
Ervaring heeft met performance advertising op Meta; TikTok is een sterke pré
Een portfolio kan laten zien met eigen ad concepts, hooks, scripts en/of briefings
Kan aantonen wat eerder ontwikkelde creatives daadwerkelijk hebben gepresteerd
Begrijpt hoe creative performance wordt gemeten aan de hand van bijvoorbeeld CTR, CPA, ROAS, hook rate en creative fatigue

Heb je voornamelijk ervaring met organische social media, brand content of algemene marketing en niet met performance creatives? Dan sluit deze functie waarschijnlijk niet aan op je ervaring.

Over TØTE

TØTE is een snelgroeiend tassenmerk, opgericht in Amsterdam vanuit één simpel idee: je hebt maar één tas nodig die alles kan.
Wat begon met het ontwikkelen van een tas die daadwerkelijk werkt voor het dagelijks leven, is uitgegroeid tot een internationaal merk met een herkenbare positie in het straatbeeld. Ons team werkt keihard aan de groei van TØTE, en we zoeken de juiste mensen die het vet vinden om hier aan mee te bouwen.

Wat ga je doen?

Deze rol bestaat om een systeem te bouwen en continu te verbeteren waarmee TØTE structureel high-performing advertising creatives ontwikkelt.

Je analyseert performance, customer insights, trends en bestaande winnaars en vertaalt deze naar nieuwe hypotheses. Vervolgens maak je daar concrete hooks, scripts, angles, concepts en briefs van waarmee het creative team direct aan de slag kan. Je bent niet alleen bezig met strategie. We verwachten dat je iedere week daadwerkelijk nieuwe concepts en tests ontwikkelt.

Jouw kernverantwoordelijkheid:

Data en customer insights vertalen naar een continue stroom van nieuwe ad concepts, hooks en iterations die onze advertising performance verbeteren.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor:

Performance-data vertalen naar nieuwe creative hypotheses en tests
Nieuwe advertising angles en concepts ontwikkelen
Hooks, scripts en messaging schrijven en aanscherpen
Customer reviews, comments, feedback en andere customer insights onderzoeken om nieuwe angles te ontdekken
Concurrenten en andere sterke DTC-brands analyseren
Meta Ad Library, TikTok en andere relevante bronnen structureel onderzoeken
Nieuwe trends, formats en platformontwikkelingen herkennen en vertalen naar advertising opportunities
Duidelijke creative briefs maken voor creators en editors
Samenwerken met de Content Director om de juiste assets en producties te realiseren
Samenwerken met onze Media Buyer om creative performance te begrijpen
Performance analyseren op onder andere CTR, CPA, ROAS, hook rate, hold rate en creative fatigue
Begrijpen waarom bepaalde creatives winnen of verliezen
Winning creatives systematisch itereren
Nieuwe varianten ontwikkelen op succesvolle hooks, angles, formats en messaging
Een duidelijke creative testing roadmap beheren
Een structurele balans creëren tussen nieuwe concepts en iterations van bestaande winnaars
Creative learnings documenteren zodat inzichten niet verloren gaan
Continu werken aan het verhogen van onze creative hit rate
AI-tools gebruiken om research, ideation, scripting en testing sneller en beter te maken

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt 2+ jaar hands-on ervaring als Creative Strategist of in een vergelijkbare performance creative rol binnen DTC/e-commerce
Je hebt zelf concepts, hooks, scripts en briefings ontwikkeld die daadwerkelijk in paid campaigns zijn gebruikt
Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met Meta Ads; TikTok Ads is een sterke pré
Je kunt concrete voorbeelden van je werk én resultaten laten zien
Je spreekt vloeiend Engels; Nederlands is een pré

Wat bieden we?

Fulltime rol (40 uur)
Een goed salaris, passend bij je ervaring
Directe impact op de groei en advertising performance van TØTE
Ownership over onze performance creative strategy
De mogelijkheid om onze creative testing engine verder op te bouwen
Veel ruimte om nieuwe concepts, angles en frameworks te testen
Nauwe samenwerking met founders, Media Buying, Content Director, creators en editors
Een klein, ambitieus en ondernemend team
Kantoor op de Prinsengracht in Amsterdam

Klaar om onze volgende winning creatives te vinden?

Als jij begrijpt dat sterke performance creative ontstaat op het snijvlak van data, consumer psychology en creativiteit, dan horen we graag van je.

Stuur ons:

Een korte motivatie

jobs.title: Creative Producer
jobs.description:
Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

We're building our own in-house content and creative team. Unlike most companies, it won't sit inside marketing as another growth channel; it runs as its own function with one objective: to make Fuse, and the abundant future we're building, impossible to ignore. As a Creative Producer, you make our campaigns happen. You, the designers and art directors run as a tag team: they own the idea and the look, you own the intelligence and the delivery. Together you take a campaign from the first insight to the final file, and when we work with external partners, you find, brief and run them.

Responsibilities

Gather the insights campaigns are built on: competitor research, category research and what's working in culture right now
Brainstorm positioning and messaging with the head of content, art director, design and whichever teams the campaign touches
Find and assess external agencies and freelancers, and write the creative briefs they work from
Run production logistics: locations, scheduling, kit, and booking the talent and crew the art director has chosen
Own the shot list and asset plan before every shoot, so one shoot day yields many assets across ads, social and campaign
Work with social strategists and creators to plan the assets they need and roll each campaign out across platforms
On big hero films, act as in-house executive producer: commission and run the named freelance crew (director, DOP, colourist, sound) and own the budget
Keep every production moving so nothing stalls or slips

Requirements

Organisation: you run the logistics, schedule and budget and keep a shoot with many moving parts on the rails, arriving with the full asset plan and leaving with every asset in the can
Problem-solving under pressure: you hold the schedule and budget when things go wrong on shoots, and protect the creative while you solve it
3+ years as a producer, with real strategic curiosity, a range of produced video and campaigns, and strong management of crews, vendors and agencies

Benefits

Competitive salary and eligibility for equity
Biannual bonus scheme
Fully expensed tech to match your needs
Private health insurance
Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees

As we hire globally, benefits vary by location.

jobs.title: AI Video & Creative Producer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Generative AI • Video • Avatare • Creative Production

Wir entwickeln die nächste Generation professioneller Bewegtbildproduktion.

Wir produzieren Produktfilme, Imagefilme, Social Content und digitale Kampagnen
und verbinden klassische Filmproduktion zunehmend mit Generative AI.

Dafür suchen wir einen AI Video & Creative Producer (m/w/d)
, der KI nicht nur als Tool kennt, sondern kreativ damit arbeiten und aus Ideen überzeugende Szenen und Filme entwickeln kann.

Aufgaben

Du entwickelst mit Generative AI eigenständig Videos, Filmszenen, Charaktere, Avatare und visuelle Konzepte
– von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Ergebnis.

Dabei arbeitest du je nach Projekt unter anderem mit:

AI Video Generation

AI Image Generation

Avataren und Digital Humans

Character Creation & Animation

Voice AI und Lip Sync

Generative VFX

AI Editing und Postproduktion

Upscaling und Video Enhancement

Kombination verschiedener KI-Tools zu effizienten Produktions-Workflows

Du kennst gängige Tools wie beispielsweise Runway, Veo, Kling, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, HeyGen oder ElevenLabs
– oder vergleichbare Systeme.

Du musst ausdrücklich nicht jedes Tool kennen
.

Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du verstehst, welches Tool für welche Aufgabe geeignet ist, neue Technologien schnell einschätzen kannst und weißt, wie daraus ein professionelles Ergebnis entsteht.

Du denkst nicht nur in Prompts – du denkst in Szenen.

Das ist für uns entscheidend.

Wir suchen keinen reinen KI-Operator, der einzelne Clips generiert und anschließend zusammenschneidet.

Wenn du eine Szene entwickelst, denkst du darüber nach:

Was passiert?

Was sieht der Zuschauer?

Welche Einstellung brauche ich?

Wie bewegt sich die Kamera?

Was macht die Figur?

Welche Emotion soll entstehen?

Wie entwickelt sich die Szene?

Wie fügt sie sich in den gesamten Film ein?

Du solltest ein gutes Gefühl für Bildsprache, Szenenaufbau, Timing, Dramaturgie und visuelles Storytelling
haben.

Du musst kein klassischer Regisseur sein.

Aber du solltest aus einer Idee selbstständig eine funktionierende visuelle Sequenz entwickeln können.

Wichtig ist uns auch: Konsistenz statt Zufall

Ein einzelner beeindruckender AI-Shot reicht für professionelle Produktionen nicht aus.

Du solltest verstehen, wie man:

Charaktere über mehrere Szenen konsistent hält

Bildwelten und Looks kontrolliert

Produkte korrekt darstellt

Referenzbilder und Keyframes nutzt

Kamerabewegungen gezielt steuert

AI-Material mit klassischem Film und Postproduktion verbindet

Kurz gesagt: Du solltest aus KI einen Produktionsprozess machen können – nicht nur gute Einzelbilder erzeugen.

Qualifikation

Must-have

praktische Erfahrung mit Generative AI für Video oder Content

Erfahrung mit AI Video Generation

Erfahrung mit Avataren, Digital Humans oder Character Generation

sicherer Umgang mit unterschiedlichen KI-Tools

sehr gutes visuelles Vorstellungsvermögen

Gefühl für Bildsprache und Gestaltung

Verständnis für Szenenaufbau, Timing und Storytelling

Fähigkeit, Projekte eigenständig von der Idee bis zum fertigen Ergebnis umzusetzen

Neugier auf neue AI-Technologien und neue Produktionsmethoden

Nice-to-have

DaVinci Resolve, Premiere oder After Effects

Editing und Postproduktion

Motion Design / VFX / Compositing

Kamera- oder Produktionserfahrung

Voice AI

ComfyUI

APIs, Automatisierung oder AI-Workflows

Benefits

Die Möglichkeit, den Aufbau eines innovativen KI-Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten.

Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Unternehmenskultur.

Kostenfreie Getränke, eigener Foodtruck und betriebliche Altersvorsorge.

Persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld.

Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

Kostenfreie Getränke, frische Verpflegungsangebote und betriebliche Altersvorsorge.

Was du bei uns machst

Du arbeitest an realen Kundenprojekten und setzt Generative AI dort ein, wo sie echten kreativen oder produktionstechnischen Mehrwert schafft.

Das kann beispielsweise sein:

Ein Produktfilm mit AI-generierten Szenen.

Ein Imagefilm mit einem digitalen Charakter.

Eine Kampagne, die Realfilm und Generative AI miteinander verbindet.

Ein vollständig AI-generierter Film.

Oder ein Format, das es heute vielleicht noch gar nicht gibt.

Dabei geht es nicht darum, möglichst viele KI-Effekte einzubauen.

Es geht darum, mit KI bessere Filme, bessere Szenen und neue Produktionsmöglichkeiten zu schaffen.

Was wir von dir sehen möchten

Für uns ist dein Portfolio wichtiger als eine lange Tool-Liste oder dein Abschluss.

Zeig uns Projekte, bei denen du KI tatsächlich kreativ eingesetzt hast.

Besonders interessant sind:

AI-Video-Projekte

AI Commercials

Avatar- oder Character-Projekte

Multi-Shot-Szenen

eigene Filme oder Experimente

Kombinationen aus AI und klassischer Produktion

Editing- und Postproduktionsarbeiten

Auch persönliche Projekte sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

Zeig uns nicht nur, welche Tools du kennst. Zeig uns, was du damit erzählen und produzieren kannst.

Kurz gesagt

Wir suchen jemanden, der KI versteht und visuell denkt.

Jemanden, der weiß, wie man einen Charakter erzeugt – aber auch, was dieser Charakter in einer Szene tun soll.

Jemanden, der einen starken Shot generieren kann – aber versteht, warum genau dieser Shot im Film gebraucht wird.

Und jemanden, der Lust darauf hat, gemeinsam mit uns herauszufinden, wie professionelle Filmproduktion mit Generative AI in Zukunft aussieht.
