### **Job Description and Duties**


Under the direction of the Nutria Eradication Operations Supervisor, the incumbent will serve as one of the lead field scientists for the Nutria Eradication Program. Nutria are highly invasive and extremely detrimental to the environment, but primarily nocturnal and relatively elusive in low densities. This position will play a critical role in the coordination of field crews conducting nutria surveys and trapping across the southern portion of the nutria infestation. The incumbent will assist the Operations Supervisor with training, leading, and evaluating field crew technicians and scientific aides to survey for, detect, and remove nutria, with the ultimate goal of eradicating nutria from the State of California. The incumbent will lead the team by example in conducting habitat suitability assessments, visual observation and camera surveys, trapping, and electronic data collection (i.e., ESRI Field Maps smartphone application), as well as effective use of baits and lures and obtaining entry permits from local landowners. The incumbent is responsible for conducting morning briefings of the assigned crew, tracking daily spatial assignments, and ensuring field staff understand understand project protocols. The incumbent will work with the Operations Supervisors, other field crew leads, and Planning Specialist to evaluate and help refine detection and trapping methods and tools for the most effective and efficient detection and removal of nutria. The incumbent will also closely coordinate with other regions and Department functions, as well as other affected and involved local, State, and Federal agencies. Work includes preparing draft reports and correspondence and answering routine questions from the public relative to Departmental nutria efforts. The primary geographical focus of this position will be in Fresno, Madera, Merced, Stanislaus, Tuolumne, Kings, Kern, and Mariposa counties, but work may be assigned in any part of the area of nutria infestation. This position is physically demanding, but highly rewarding given the ultimate accomplishment of protecting California's wetlands, waterways, infrastructure, and agriculture from the devastation nutria have caused in other regions of North America.
Incumbent must be willing and able to competently use firearms as per the Department’s Policy for Non\-Enforcement Personnel. Must be willing and able to competently use and possess wildlife restraint drugs and equipment. Must wear a Department uniform.  

  

  

**Personal Leave Program:** Effective July 1, 2025, state employees are subject to temporary salary reductions ranging from 2% to 4\.62% in exchange for Personal Leave Program (PLP) hours. Please note that the salary ranges listed in this Job Control may not reflect these reductions associated with the 2025 Personal Leave Program.  

Please follow the link for more information regarding the 2025 Personal Leave program:  

Personal Leave Program \- Human Resources \- CalHR.  

  

  

Link to Environmental Scientist Exam: CalCareers  

  

  

**This position is a 12\-month Limited Term (LT) and may be extended up to 24 months or become permanent.**  

  

During this 12\-month Limited Term assignment, you will receive full health, dental, and vision benefits! You will also earn State Service and accrue monthly leave credits.  

You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**.


### **Working Conditions**


Must be willing to work atypical hours and on weekends. Some overnight travel may be required (up to 5%). Must be able to swim, walk through deep mud and thick vegetation, work on steep or uneven terrain, in extreme weather and under physically challenging conditions. Must be willing and able to competently use pellet pistols or firearms as per the Department’s Policy for Non\-Enforcement Personnel. Willing to handle live animals and carcasses, dispatch animals, and conduct simple tissue sampling and necropsies. Must possess valid Driver's License and be able to safely and effectively operate watercraft and and Utility Task Vehicles (UTV)s, as well as tow trailers. This job requires daily operation of State vehicles to reach field sites, regular use of kayaks, and occasional operation of UTVs and motorized watercraft. Must wear Department uniform. Must be willing and able to obtain a California Boater Card and other motorboat operator certifications as determined necessary.  

  

  

The primary geographical focus of this position will be in Fresno, Madera, Merced, Stanislaus, Tuolumne, Kings, Kern, and Mariposa counties, but work may be assigned in any part of the area of nutria infestation.
  

This is a 12\-month limited\-term position but may be extended to 24 months based on performance and availability of funding.

The County of Orange, Health Care Agency (HCA) is a dynamic organization dedicated to creating and supporting an environment that promotes the achievement of optimal individual, family and community health. Solid waste facilities in Orange County are required to hold permits from the Local Enforcement Agency (LEA).

**Position Description**
------------------------

  

  

**SUMMARY OF POSITION**
The Environmental Health Bureau sits within the County of Monterey’s Department of Health and consists of seven major environmental health regulatory programs: Healthy Housing Services, Consumer Health Protection Services, Drinking Water Protection Services, Environmental Health Review (Land Use) Services, Hazardous Materials Management Services, Recycling and Resource Recovery Services, and Solid Waste Management Services.  

  

The Environmental Health Bureau is seeking to fill one full\-time Environmental Health Specialist IV (EHS IV) for the Healthy Housing Services program.  

  

The Healthy Housing Services program is responsible for ensuring safe and healthy living environments through the inspection and enforcement of state and local housing regulations for residential rental housing, employee housing, detention facilities, and other regulated facilities. The program investigates housing complaints, addresses substandard housing conditions, conducts vector control and agricultural field toilet inspections, supports the Childhood Lead Poisoning Prevention Program, and performs other environmental health activities designed to protect community health and prevent environmental health hazards.  

  

The EHS IV is a supervisory/leadership position whose primary responsibility is to actively support the Director of Environmental Health's goals and vision by performing supervisory tasks such as administrative oversight and quality assurance of environmental health programs. This role is to ensure activities are completed by providing timely feedback to staff while reviewing their work, spotting trends, and ensuring proper follow\-up. The EHS IV guides the team to effectively meet performance measures and maintain high standards of practice. Several programs also include grant funded projects where substantive administrative, contract policy and technical issues require specialized analysis, strategic planning, stakeholder collaboration, program recommendation and public outreach. This position is responsible for managing their program by utilizing team resources efficiently, thorough planning, delegating tasks to staff, monitoring progress and frequent communication.

Directive is a revenue\-first marketing consultancy built to serve B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, industrial, and commerce brands. We don't make things look good for its own sake. We build visual systems that hold up under the pressure of performance channels, complex professional services positioning, and a buying audience that starts with a CMO and ends with a CFO.


We are looking for an Associate Creative Director who will translate Moments that Matter into creative territories, messaging hypotheses, campaign concepts, headlines, CTAs, and copy direction that designers can execute against. The Associate Creative Director will bring senior\-level creative judgment to work that is fast\-moving, digital\-first, and tied directly to business outcomes. This person will not simply wait for polished briefs or execute one\-off design requests. jobs.title: Chemical Safety Expert for AI Model Safety Audit
jobs.description:
\#\# Description SME Careers is hiring chemists and chemical safety professionals to audit how AI models respond to sensitive questions in the field. Each task gives you a user request and the answers three different models gave to it. You classify the request (benign, dual\-use or adversarial), mark each answer as safe or unsafe and say why, rank the three against each other, and write the answer the model should have given. For dual\-use requests you also note what makes it sensitive, what legitimate purpose it serves, and who should be able to get an answer. The requests are realistic: what synthetic and analytical chemists, toxicologists, industrial hygienists, process safety engineers, regulators and occasionally bad actors actually ask. Some are ordinary professional questions that models wrongly refuse, and catching those matters as much as catching the dangerous ones. \#\# Who we're looking for Synthetic and analytical chemists; toxicologists and pharmacologists; industrial hygienists and chemical safety/process safety professionals; CWC or chemical\-security specialists; hazmat, poison\-control or chemical incident responders; and chemical regulators (EPA, OSHA, HSE, OPCW\-adjacent, or equivalent). Usually a relevant degree plus five or more years of professional experience. jobs.description:
**About Us**
============

At Onterris, we build careers grounded in purpose, responsibility and real\-world impact.


“For Planet and Progress” is our north star that guides everything we do. We believe environmental responsibility and human progress are interconnected, interwoven and international. Our scientists, engineers, field teams, consultants and professionals collaborate across disciplines and geographies, guiding industries and governments, ensuring that communities and environments thrive.


When you join us, you’re not just forging a career, you’re joining a movement. A movement for better thinking, smarter solutions and lasting impact.


Together, we will advance our way of life and protect the integrity of our environment every step of the way.

Our team is experienced in planning and executing environmental site assessment and remediation projects which improve the health and wellbeing of the communities that we live in.


In this role, you’ll provide strategic and practical solutions to clients with a broad range of environmental management challenges under the guidance of an experienced Project Director. Your role will predominantly include interpretation of technical data, preparation of technical reports, and presenting information in a clear and logical manner, with additional opportunities in project management, planning and delivery. You will primarily work on a large fuel facility remediation program, involving complex and unique approaches to site assessment, management and remediation. About ValidA little about us: We’re Valid, Valid isn’t just a performance or content agency. We’re a product-driven creative company with an in-house engineering team that builds tools to test, learn, and scale what works. We combine strategy, creative, and AI to turn insights into systems, helping brands move faster and make better decisions across every channel.



The RoleThis is a senior leadership role for someone who can sit at the center of client growth, creative performance, and internal execution, and make all three move faster.

Your job is not simply to oversee deliverables.

Your job is to make sure the work we put into client accounts wins.

That means understanding the client’s business deeply, recognizing that what they ask for is not always what they actually need, and having the strategic confidence to redirect, refine, and shape the work into something that outperforms what is already running.

You must be equally comfortable:

leading creative direction,

building testing strategy,

pitching directly to clients,

managing high-level relationships,

pushing back when necessary,

and translating all of that into clear internal execution.

This is a hands-on operator role.

You cannot lead this from above.

You must know how to build strategy, create strong concepts, understand AI production, and step into the work yourself when needed. The team should move faster because your expertise is in the room.

This role sits at the intersection of:

creative leadership, performance strategy, client trust, and speed.

The pace is aggressive.

Clients move fast. Ad accounts move faster. So do we.



What You’ll Actually OwnClient Strategy & Relationship Leadership

You will be the senior strategic voice on key accounts.

That means understanding each client’s business model, offer, funnel, and performance landscape, knowing what is working and failing in their account, and identifying where creative can become the growth lever.

Clients will often tell us what they think they need.

Your job is to identify the real problem underneath the ask and guide them toward the right solution.

You should be able to command trust quickly, pitch with confidence, and build relationships that make clients want to follow your lead.

Creative Performance Direction

You are responsible for ensuring the creative strategy is built to outperform.

This means:

building testing plans around real account opportunities,

identifying which hooks, offers, formats, and angles should be attacked next,

steering concepts toward performance over subjective preference,

and making sure every batch of work has a strategic reason for existing.

You are not approving ads because they look good.

You are approving ads because you understand why they should win.

The expectation is simple: our work should beat what the client was running before we got there.

Internal Team Leadership

You will lead internal creatives, editors, strategists, and producers with speed and clarity.

You must be able to take a messy client conversation, extract the strategic signal, convert it into actionable briefs, sharpen weak ideas, and keep production moving without bottlenecks.

You are the connective tissue between client expectation and final output.

Pitching, Selling & Expanding Trust

This role is highly outward-facing.

You should be able to present concepts persuasively, defend strategic choices, handle skepticism, and continually reinforce that we know how to make accounts perform.

Strong communication matters here as much as strong creative instinct.

Long-term retention often comes down to whether the client believes we see opportunities they do not.



Who This Is ForThis is for someone who:

understands performance creative deeply,

thinks strategically beyond what is asked,

can lead clients without becoming a yes-person,

can lead teams without babysitting,

can pitch with conviction,

and thrives in a fast, demanding environment.

This is not a clock-in, clock-out role.

Priorities shift. Problems appear. Speed matters.

The people who thrive here are the ones who know how to solve, adapt, and keep moving.

Meet Siena

Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

The team

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading.

The Role

Siena is shipping faster than the market can absorb, and the words are not keeping up. The market learns about what we build too late, and when it does, the writing doesn't do the product justice. Today launch content is written by the founders and the growth team between everything else, and nobody owns it.

With several product launches back to back over the next two quarters and a Founding Creative Director coming in to own the visuals, we need one person who owns every word Siena puts in front of the market: founder-led LinkedIn, the company voice on socials, launches, blog posts, announcements, the scripts behind our videos.

You decide what we say, where, and how often, and then you write it. There is no content team underneath you and no copywriters to hand things to. You make the thing.

What You'll Do

You own all of Siena's content: if it goes out under the Siena name and the market reads it, you wrote it or you signed off on it.
You set the strategy for founder-led LinkedIn and the company's own social accounts, write the posts, and own what they do.
You ship every product launch with its words ready, announcement, blog, social sequence and founder posts, working with the Creative Director so the words and the visuals land as one thing.
You write the scripts for every product video and marketing video, from the launch film to a 30-second product clip, and the Creative Director brings them to screen.
You study trends and top performing posts, in our category and outside it, and turn that into a point of view the team can act on, not a swipe file.
You know which content moved something, why, and where to double down, and you kill what doesn't work without being asked.
You use AI in every part of the work, research, drafting, analysis, distribution, and move faster than a content team would. Your taste is the final filter.

Who You Are

The Bar:
If you're missing any of these, this isn't the role for you.

Published writing you can show across blog posts, launch announcements, social, and video scripts.
You have shipped content as the only writer at a company or brand, with no team or copywriters behind you.
You have worked in eCommerce or marketed to consumer brands and understand how their teams operate.

Strong Signal:
Not dealbreakers, but what separates a good hire from a great one.

You were writing professionally before the current AI tools, and you can tell the difference between a sentence that sounds right and one that's true.
You can point to writing that changed what someone did, e.g. the line that got a head of CX to book the demo, the founder post that got forwarded inside a company, the launch that landed.
You use AI in every part of your work and none of it reads like AI.
You measure your own work and change course on the evidence, not on taste alone.
You have run founder-led or executive content before and can show what it did.

Nice to Have:
Bonus, not required.

CX experience in eCommerce, on the brand side or the vendor side.
You have marketed AI, automation, or customer experience products.

Not a Fit If:

You need a content team or copywriters underneath you to produce output.
You think content strategy is a calendar. A calendar isn't a point of view.
You are anti-AI, or you use AI and ship the first draft. Both are disqualifying.
Your best work happens on a slow, protected timeline. Here it's multiple launches in flight and feedback in hours, not weeks.

Why Siena?

Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.

Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

Our values

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback - both giving and receiving it - because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.

Our approach to AI

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

At Siena, we're not just looking for people who can do a job. We're looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that's you, we look forward to your application.

How We Hire

We use AI-assisted screening tools as part of our hiring process. All decisions are made by humans. You can request a human-only review at talent@siena.cx.

Siena provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

We are a performance marketing agency that helps law firms acquire signed retainers. This position focuses on creative strategy and day-to-day creative direction. It does not include hiring, personnel management, or media buying responsibilities.

• Develop new advertising concepts, hooks, and creative angles each week.

• Plan and execute creative tests across hooks, formats, and messaging angles.

Required Qualifications

jobs.title: UGC Creator Needed for Real Estate Ads (Real People Only, NO AI Actors) - Raw Footage
jobs.description:
**UGC Creator Needed for Real Estate Facebook Ads (Real People Only, NO AI Actors) - Raw Footage**

We're looking for a real UGC creator to record authentic, selfie-style videos for our real estate Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns.

**Please note:** We are only accepting real, on-camera UGC creators. AI-generated avatars, AI voiceovers, synthetic videos, or any AI-created content will not be considered.

## Project Details

• Industry: Real Estate

• Usage: Paid advertising on Facebook and Instagram

• Estimated filming time: Approximately 2 hours

• Filming style: Natural iPhone selfie-style videos that feel authentic and conversational, as if you're talking to a friend. Avoid making the videos feel overly scripted or like a commercial.

• Delivery: Raw footage only (no editing required)

• Timeline: Flexible

## What You'll Be Recording

You'll receive 3 different scripts, each approximately 30–40 seconds long.

Each script will be recorded in 3 different locations (for example: inside your home, outside, in your car, office, or another natural setting).

The script itself will stay exactly the same. The only thing that changes is the filming location and the overall setting to create more variety for our ad creatives.

To help the videos feel more authentic, we encourage natural camera movement whenever it makes sense. Walking while talking, slightly moving the phone, changing your angle naturally, or filming in locations with some background activity are all great ways to make the content feel more dynamic. We want the videos to look like genuine UGC, not a polished commercial.

It's perfectly okay to glance away from the camera naturally from time to time, just as you would during a normal conversation. The goal is to sound relaxed and authentic rather than feeling like you're reading from a script.

## Wardrobe

We recommend a clean, professional, business casual look.

Since each script is filmed in 3 different locations, we'd like you to wear a different shirt in each location. You can absolutely reuse the same shirts throughout the project, as long as each location has a different look. This helps make each video feel like it was filmed on different days and gives us more creative variety for testing ads.

## Deliverables

• 3 unique scripts

• 3 filming locations per script

• 9 raw videos total (30–40 seconds each)

Scripts:

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1lOx8vKYYnA13V16P-Svpr21eFttctajm8rDMy9HFA54/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.i989s9wxjtj5

## To Apply

Please include:

• Examples of previous UGC or selfie-style videos you've created.

• A portfolio, media kit, or any presentation showcasing your previous work.

• The type of phone you'll be filming with (iPhone preferred).

• Your estimated turnaround time.

We're looking for someone who is comfortable speaking naturally on camera and can create authentic, engaging content that performs well in paid advertising. If you're a good fit, we'd love to see your application!

YOUR CREATIVE FIELD

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Performance Creative Strategist to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).

As our new Performance Creative Strategist, you will own one of the most direct levers of growth at Contabo Group, a profitable, fast-growing European cloud infrastructure provider backed by KKR and Oakley Capital. Across Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube, you will decide which ideas get tested, which assets get built, and which concepts get scaled, giving you real ownership and real impact from day one.

You develop and execute creative strategies for every paid channel we run, translating audience insights and funnel data into sharp, performance-driven briefs. From there, you brief and collaborate closely with designers, copywriters, and video producers to bring those concepts to life, and you build the A/B and multivariate testing frameworks that tell us which ones actually win. You read the numbers behind every creative (CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS), know when to kill a concept and when to scale it, and turn those insights into channel-specific playbooks the whole team can build on.

Because we operate in B2B cloud infrastructure, this role comes with its own puzzle: turning technical, often complex value propositions into ad concepts people actually stop scrolling for. You stay close to platform updates, algorithm shifts, and creative trends across every channel we use, and translate all of it into a systematic testing framework rather than gut feeling.

You will report directly to our Head of Performance Marketing and work within an international, English-speaking team with a flat hierarchy, where you build creative processes from scratch rather than inheriting a rigid one. As we grow, so does the scope of this role, giving you real visibility and a fast path toward owning creative strategy end to end.

WHAT CONVINCES US

Your personality, paired with:

Senior track record at the intersection of creative and performance, spanning concepts, ad copy, hooks, and visual direction, with real ownership of creative KPIs, not just campaign KPIs
Proven experience acting as the creative bridge between performance marketing and creative or product teams, translating offers, product messaging, and campaign goals into platform-ready assets, and briefing designers, copywriters, and UX/UI colleagues with precise, performance-oriented creative briefs

jobs.title: Creative Strategist (Video & Static Ads) - Romania
jobs.description:
Come and join the fastest growing Google Ads agency in the world, and own AI ad creative for YouTube from the first angle to the finished asset.

About Us:

Adcubator is the fastest growing Google Ads agency in the world. Led by our founder and CEO, Jem, we manage nine figures in annual ad spend across 180+ ecommerce DTC brands, powered by direct relationships with Google's product teams and access to alpha and beta features most agencies never touch. Our strategies are not public, our standards are high, and our results do the talking.

We grow fast because the work is that good, and we keep the team senior and selective on purpose. Our average client stays with us well beyond a year, close to unheard of in this industry. Join us and you plug into a team operating at the top of the game, and a founder whose personal brand is becoming the loudest signal in performance marketing.

The Role:

You own AI creative from the strategy down to the finished ad, with YouTube as the main focus, especially 16x9. That means the thinking and the making: research the market, define the avatars and personas, find the angles, then concept, script, generate, edit, and ship. We run across placements too, so you will build for other formats when the test calls for it, but YouTube is where you live. You build the formats bigger brands are scaling right now, AI VSLs, claymation, AI avatars, UGC hybrids, and the ones landing next month before they go mainstream.

This is a full ownership role. You are not handing an idea to a producer and waiting, and you are not waiting on a strategist to hand you a brief. You read the data, you decide the angle, you make the ad, and you iterate on what the numbers tell you. We test creative at volume and buy against real spend, so your work is live within days, not quarters. The best person for this treats creative as a testing problem, not an art project.

Requirements:

Proven experience concepting and producing ecommerce ad creative that ran on real spend, YouTube especially

You think in angles, avatars, and personas, and you can research a market before you touch a tool

Daily, fluent use of AI creative tools: Atria, Higgsfield, Claude, Manus, fal.ai, and whatever ships next. You already run these, we are not teaching them.

Comfortable reading performance data and letting it drive the next round of creative

Ability to own the full process solo, from research and strategy to finished asset

A real grasp of direct response, not just clean visuals

A testing mindset built on volume, variation, and reading what actually converts

Genuinely obsessed with new formats and models the week they drop

Responsibilities:

Research the market, the audience, and the competition to find angles worth testing

Define avatars and personas, and build creative concepts around them

Concept, script, generate, edit, and deliver AI ad creative end to end, with YouTube and 16x9 as the priority

Build for other placements and formats when a test calls for it

Build AI VSLs and the formats scaling right now: claymation, AI avatars, UGC hybrids, motion styles

Run a high volume creative testing pipeline, read the results honestly, and iterate on what wins

Stay ahead of every new tool and format in the space, and bring them in first

Feed winning creative into the media buying team and align with the content and landing page people so angle, page, and offer line up

What we offer:

Fully remote. Work from anywhere, with flexible hours.

A seat inside a premium agency managing nine figures in ad spend, making creative that runs on real budgets from day one.

A small, senior, global team with no bureaucracy and no busywork.

Paid time off.

A wellness bonus.

Team retreats and workations.

How to apply:

Submit your application through the form below. Include:
Your CV

Your portfolio

A short motivational letter: why this role, and why you

We can spot an AI written application instantly, and it goes straight in the bin. Show us how you actually think and work.

Good luck.
The Adcubator Team.

jobs.title: Creative Lead
jobs.description:
Meet Aperture

At Aperture, we create value and drive growth by delivering exceptional product consultancy and advertising services to our global partners.

Through data-driven strategies, we combine performance marketing, creative strategy, product optimisation, CRM, analytics and experimentation to help ambitious companies scale.

Founded in 2022 by Hannah Parvaz, Aperture has quickly made waves. Already recognised as Business Consultant of the Year and named 2024's Most Innovative Growth Agency, we're now building the team that will take us into our next stage of growth.

We work with some of the most exciting apps, platforms and digital products in the world. Our job is not just to make things look good. Our job is to make growth happen.

Our culture

Growth mindset. We're hungry to learn and improve
Take full responsibility for every outcome - no excuses
Obsess over results. We're here to make a measurable impact
We're data-obsessed. We let numbers, not opinions, guide our decisions
Client success is our success. Period
No ego. The best idea wins, regardless of who it comes from
Radical candour. We give and receive honest feedback to fuel growth
No job is too small. We support each other and JFDI

Work from anywhere

We're remote-first and impact-first.

Work from wherever you're most productive, while staying closely connected to the team through regular collaboration, team sessions, client work and in-person meetups.

We also bring the team together for retreats, events, conferences and working sessions around the world. Travel to team meetups is covered.

You must be able to work in a UK timezone.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Creative Lead to lead and develop Aperture's performance creative function.

You'll combine creative strategy, customer psychology, copywriting, experimentation and performance analysis to improve the quality of our thinking and output.

You'll lead our Creative Strategists, set the standard for creative work across Aperture, and help teams turn customer insight and performance data into strong concepts, briefs and experiments.

You'll be comfortable moving between:

Customer psychology
Jobs to be done
Copywriting
Performance creative
Experimentation
Internet culture
Performance analysis
Product positioning
AI workflows
Team leadership

You'll need exceptional judgement, strong writing skills, sharp analytical thinking and an instinctive understanding of how people behave.

Why this role matters

Creative is one of the biggest levers in paid growth.

Strong creative teams need to understand the customer, the product, the platform and the performance data behind the work.

They need to know:

What job they are hiring a product to do
What customers actually care about
What makes a message believable
How to structure an experiment
Which ideas deserve testing
Why something won or lost
What should happen next

The Creative Lead is responsible for raising that standard across Aperture.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop our Creative Strategists.

Lead senior creative conversations with clients.

Set the standard for creative strategy, copy and briefing.

Write and edit hooks, scripts, headlines and messaging.

Use AI to improve research, ideation, analysis and iteration.

Build clear hypotheses and structured creative experiments.

Review performance and turn results into the next round of ideas.

Raise the quality bar across UGC, video, static and creator-led work.

Build simple systems for capturing learnings and improving creative over time.

Spot trends, behaviours and cultural shifts early and judge when they are relevant.

Turn customer research, jobs to be done and performance data into strong creative angles.

Work closely with Pod Leads and Growth teams to connect creative with wider performance.

Requirements

Excellent attention to detail
Exceptional copywriting skills
Strong strategic and analytical thinking
Strong client-facing communication skills
Active use of AI in your creative workflow
Experience managing and developing creative people
Deep familiarity with internet culture and emerging trends
Strong experience in performance creative or creative strategy
Strong understanding of experimentation and performance data
Deep understanding of customer psychology and jobs to be done
Excellent knowledge of Meta, TikTok, UGC and short-form creative

Before you apply

Experience in apps, subscriptions, DTC or other performance-driven businesses is a strong plus.

Before you apply

We read every single application.

We ask a few questions as part of the process. This is where we understand how you think.

We're not looking for perfect answers. We're looking for real ones.

Specific examples matter more than polished language.

We can tell when something is generic.

Take your time. Write from your own experience

jobs.title: Digital Marketing (Paid Media & Tracking)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Digital Marketing (Paid Media & Tracking) based in Portugal.

This hands-on digital marketing role focuses on paid media execution, advertising analytics, and reliable conversion tracking.

You will help manage campaigns across multiple advertising platforms while ensuring that every important customer interaction is accurately measured.

The role combines digital advertising with technical tracking, requiring you to work directly with pixels, events, analytics tools, and campaign data.

You will investigate discrepancies, troubleshoot broken events, and improve the reliability of the tracking infrastructure behind paid campaigns.

Working closely with the marketing team, you will support campaign setup, audience tracking, retargeting, attribution, and performance measurement.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys solving practical technical problems and understanding how data moves across marketing systems.

You will work in a fast-paced, fully remote environment where attention to detail, curiosity, and hands-on execution are highly valued.

Accountabilities

The Digital Marketing (Paid Media & Tracking) professional will support the day-to-day operation of paid media and tracking systems, ensuring campaigns are properly configured and marketing data is captured accurately across platforms.

Set up, manage, and troubleshoot Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, custom events, and conversion configurations.
Support paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other relevant platforms.
Define and maintain consistent event tracking structures, including event names, parameters, properties, and conversion definitions.
Implement and validate pixels, events, conversion tracking, UTM parameters, and other tracking solutions across websites and campaigns.
Work with tools including PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Events Manager, Brevo, and Microsoft Clarity.
Monitor tracking performance and investigate discrepancies between advertising platforms, analytics systems, and website data.
Diagnose tracking issues and determine why events or conversions are not firing, recording, or attributing correctly.
Test and validate events across multiple platforms to ensure accurate and consistent data collection.
Ensure key events and conversions are correctly defined, captured, and attributed.
Assist with campaign setup, audience tracking, retargeting, and conversion measurement.
Analyze campaign and tracking data to identify technical issues and opportunities for optimization.
Collaborate with website and landing-page workflows to ensure accurate data collection and attribution.
Maintain clear documentation for event naming conventions, tracking structures, and implementation processes.
Stay informed about changes in advertising platforms, tracking technologies, attribution methods, and privacy requirements.
Test and troubleshoot new tracking configurations before campaigns go live.

Requirements

The ideal candidate is practical, detail-oriented, and technically curious, with the ability to work directly inside advertising and analytics platforms. You should understand the full tracking journey from event definition through data capture, attribution, and conversion reporting.

Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events or conversions.
Experience with TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
Practical experience using PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Microsoft Clarity, and Brevo.
Strong understanding of event tracking concepts, including event names, parameters, properties, conversion definitions, and attribution.
Experience troubleshooting tracking problems and identifying why events or conversions fail to fire, record, or attribute correctly.
Familiarity with server-side tracking and Conversions API is a strong plus.
Experience with emerging advertising platforms, including ChatGPT Ads, is an advantage.
Comfortable working with spreadsheets, dashboards, analytics data, and campaign performance reports.
Basic understanding of website elements and the technical implementation of tracking solutions.
Strong attention to detail and an analytical, hands-on approach to problem solving.
Ability to investigate issues independently and identify practical solutions.
Comfortable working across multiple paid media channels and quickly learning new platforms and technologies.
Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with marketing and other cross-functional teams.
Ability to balance campaign execution with accurate measurement and data quality.

Benefits

Fully remote position.
Opportunity to work across multiple paid advertising and analytics platforms.
Hands-on experience with modern tracking, attribution, and marketing technology.
Exposure to Meta, TikTok, Reddit, LinkedIn, PostHog, GA4, GTM, and other digital marketing tools.
Opportunity to develop expertise at the intersection of paid media, analytics, and marketing technology.
Fast-paced environment with an international and diverse remote team.
Significant hands-on ownership of campaign tracking and measurement infrastructure.
Opportunity to work with emerging advertising and tracking technologies.
Role focused on practical execution, troubleshooting, experimentation, and continuous learning.

jobs.title: Content Producer
jobs.description:
About Eucalyptus

We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. More than 1 billion people live with obesity worldwide, driving preventable chronic conditions. We're here to build better long-term care.

Eucalyptus is now part of Hims & Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness.

Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our published clinical research shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times.

Our Growth Story

Supporting patients living with obesity across our 5 markets
Received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS
Tailored our offering to thousands of patients in Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan and Canada.

The role

We're looking for a Creative Producer with a strong Art Director streak. You own the make end-to-end — concept, look, shoot, edit — but the emphasis here is on craft and visual direction
: you're the person who decides how the work looks and feels, sets the bar, and makes sure every asset that leaves the studio is something we're proud to put spend behind.

You'll concept and art-direct performance creative that beats the agency benchmark, then produce it — running the shoot, directing talent and the bench, and steering the edit. Your masters become the "gold standard" the rest of the pipeline expands into hundreds of variations, so the quality of your output sets the ceiling for everything.

This is a hands-on, high-output role for a swiss-army-knife operator: equal parts taste, ideas and get-it-done.

What you'll do

Own the visual craft and direction of Weight Loss creative — art-direct the look, feel, and quality bar across video and static.
Concept performance-led ideas rooted in what actually works — hooks, angles, formats — not just what looks nice.
Produce end-to-end: plan and run shoots, direct talent and our on-camera bench, and steer edits to a finished standard.
Set the "gold standard" masters that the Manila team and AI iterate and expand from — and keep raising that bar.
Partner with strategists (who own the why and what) and our designers/editors to turn ideas into finished, on-brand assets fast.
Work at pace and volume without letting craft slip — you're comfortable shipping a lot and keeping it sharp.
Help shape the studio's visual identity and creative standards as we scale.

What You'll Bring

A strong portfolio of performance and/or brand creative — with a clear eye for art direction, composition, type and visual craft.
Real production experience: you can plan and run a shoot, direct talent, and take something from idea to finished asset yourself.
Hands-on editing/design ability — enough to set the standard, jump in, and unblock others (Premiere/After Effects, Figma/Adobe CS or similar).
A performance instinct: you understand social-native, direct-response creative and what makes an ad actually convert, not just look good.
A bias for output and iteration — you ship, learn and ship again, without being precious.
Comfortable directing people (talent, crew, the bench) and collaborating closely with strategists and editors.

Why join Eucalyptus?

Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (Pilot, Kin, Software) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, and skincare.

Here’s What Makes Joining Euc Unique

What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.
Build something world-changing - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.
Make real impact - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.
Accelerate your growth - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.
Join a motivated team - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

What’s ahead in the UK

Be an owner – Your own stake in the business with our employee options program
Invest in your growth – Annual development budget plus 3 days of professional development leave
Work flexibly – Hybrid setup with 3 days a week in our Old Street office, designed for focus and collaboration
Support your well-being – Private health insurance through Vitality or opt for a monthly wellness allowance to spend on what matters most to you
Take time off – 25 days of holiday, enhanced parental leave and work from anywhere 3 weeks out of the year
Join a connected team – A vibrant office culture with regular socials, clubs, after-school sport, and seasonal events
